For this service of ministry not only meets the needs of the saints, but also overflows in many expressions of gratitude to God.

Through the tested character of this service, they will glorify God because of the submission that flows from your confession of the gospel of Christ and because of the generosity you share with them and with everyone else.
And as they pray for you, they express deep affection for you because of the surpassing grace of God that rests upon you.

verses.heading: Notes / Notes
verses.text: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift. 9 Quoted from Ps. 112:9

verses.heading: Paul’s Defense of His Apostolic Ministry / Paul’s Defense of His Apostolic Ministry
verses.text: Now I, Paul myself, appeal to you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ—I who am said to be humble when face to face with you, but bold toward you when absent.
I ask that when I am present, I will not need to exercise boldness with the confidence I intend to use against some who think that we live according to merely human standards.
For although we live in the body, we do not conduct our warfare according to human means,
because the weapons of our warfare are not merely human, but are powerful through God for the destruction of strongholds.
We are tearing down arguments and every proud obstacle that rises up against the knowledge of God, and we are bringing every thought into captivity to obey Christ.
We are also prepared to deal with every act of disobedience, once your obedience is complete.
You are judging by outward appearance. If anyone is convinced that he belongs to Christ, let him consider again that just as he belongs to Christ, so do we.
For even if I boast somewhat freely about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than tearing you down, I will not be put to shame.
I do not want to seem as though I am trying to frighten you by means of my letters.
For some say, “His letters are weighty and forceful, but his physical presence is unimpressive and his speech is disregarded.”
Let such a person understand that what we are in our letters when absent, we will also be in our actions when present.

For we do not dare to classify or compare ourselves with those who commend themselves. When they measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves, they show a lack of understanding.
But we will not boast beyond proper limits. Instead, we will boast according to the measure of the sphere of ministry that God has assigned to us, which includes even you.
For we are not overreaching, as though we had not come to you, since we did in fact come to you with the gospel of Christ.

We are not boasting beyond proper limits in the labors of others. Rather, we have the hope that as your faith grows, our sphere of ministry among you will be greatly expanded within the boundaries God has assigned to us,
so that we may proclaim the gospel in regions beyond you, without boasting in what has already been accomplished in someone else’s area of ministry.
But “the one who boasts must boast in the Lord.”*

verses.heading: Notes / Notes
verses.text: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends. 17 Quoted from Jer. 9:24

verses.heading: Paul and the False Apostles / Paul and the False Apostles
verses.text: I ask you to bear with me in a display of what may seem foolish—but in truth, you are already bearing with me.
For I am intensely jealous for you, with the very jealousy of God, because I have betrothed you to one husband, that you might be presented as a pure virgin to Christ.
Yet I am concerned that, just as the serpent deceived Eve through his cunning, your minds might be led astray from the simplicity and the purity that is in Christ.
For if anyone comes preaching a Jesus different from the One we proclaimed, or a spirit you did not receive, or a gospel you did not accept, you tolerate it all too easily.
I consider myself in no way inferior to these so-called “super-apostles.”
Even if I am unskilled in speech, I am not lacking in knowledge; indeed, we have demonstrated this to you fully in every way.
Did I commit a wrong by humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because I preached the gospel of God to you without charge?
I accepted assistance from other churches—at their expense—so that I could serve you.

And when I was present with you and in need, I did not burden anyone, because the brothers from Macedonia supplied my needs. In all things, I kept myself from being a burden to you, and I will continue to do so.
As the truth of Christ is in me, this boasting of mine will not be silenced in the regions of Achaia.
Why? Is it because I do not love you? God knows that I do!
What I am doing, I will continue to do, in order to remove any opportunity from those who seek one, so that they may be shown to be no better than we are in what they boast about.
Such individuals are false apostles; they are deceptive workers who deliberately present themselves as apostles of Christ.
And this should not surprise anyone, since even Satan makes himself appear as an angel of light.
So it is no remarkable thing if his agents also present themselves as ministers of righteousness; their final outcome will correspond to what they have done.

verses.heading: The Apostolic Sufferings of Paul / The Apostolic Sufferings of Paul
verses.text: Again I say, let no one consider me foolish. But if they do, then receive me as foolish, so that I may boast a little.
What I say, I do not speak as the Lord commands, but in this confidence of foolish boasting.
Since many boast according to human standards, I also will boast.
For you, being wise, gladly tolerate fools.
You endure it if someone enslaves you, devours you, exploits you, exalts himself, or strikes you in the face.
I speak in shame: we have been weak. Yet in whatever anyone else dares to boast about—I speak in foolishness—I also dare to boast.

Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they Abraham’s offspring? So am I. Are they servants of Christ? I am even more so: in far greater labors, in more imprisonments, in beatings beyond measure, and in frequent dangers of death.
Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.
Three times I was beaten with rods, once stoned, three times shipwrecked, and I spent a day and a night adrift at sea.
I have been on many journeys, in dangers from rivers, from robbers, from my own countrymen, from Gentiles; in cities, in the wilderness, at sea; in dangers among false brothers.
I have endured labor and hardship, through many sleepless nights, in hunger and thirst, often without food, in cold and exposure.
Beyond all this, there is the daily pressure of concern for all the churches.
Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who falls into sin, and I do not burn with righteous indignation?
If it is necessary to boast, I will boast about my weaknesses.
The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is blessed forever, knows that I am not lying.
In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas was guarding the city to seize me,
but I was lowered in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his hands.

verses.heading: Paul’s Visions and Revelations and His Thorn in the Flesh / Paul’s Visions and Revelations and His Thorn in the Flesh
verses.text: I must continue boasting, though it brings no benefit or profit to me; yet I will proceed to speak of visions and revelations that the Lord has granted me.

I know a man who belongs to Christ—this happened fourteen years ago—whether he was in his physical body or transported out of his body, I cannot say; only God knows the answer. This man was caught up and transported into the third heaven.
And I know this same man—whether in his physical body or apart from his body, I do not know; God alone knows—
that he was caught up into Paradise itself and heard words so sacred and profound that they cannot be expressed in human language, words which no person is permitted to utter or repeat.
Concerning this man and his experience, I will boast and glory; but concerning my own self, I will not boast, except to glory in the things that reveal my weaknesses and frailties.

For even if I should choose to boast about such experiences, I would not be acting foolishly, because I would be telling the truth. But I refrain from doing so, so that no one will form an opinion of me that goes beyond what he actually observes in my conduct or hears directly from my teaching.

And so that I would not become proud or exalt myself because of the extraordinary nature of these revelations, a thorn was embedded in my flesh—a messenger or agent of Satan sent to torment and buffet me—so that I would not lift myself up in pride.
Concerning this affliction, I pleaded earnestly with the Lord on three separate occasions, asking that it might be removed from me.

And He responded to me, saying, “My grace is all you need and is fully adequate for you, for My power reaches its full strength and is made complete in the midst of human weakness.” Therefore, with the greatest joy and eagerness, I will boast in my weaknesses and infirmities, so that the power of Christ may dwell upon me and make its home in me.

verses.heading: Paul’s Concern for the Corinthian Believers / Paul’s Concern for the Corinthian Believers
verses.text: I have become foolish, as compelled by you. I ought to have been commended by you. For I am in no way inferior to these “super-apostles,” even though I am nothing in myself.
Indeed, the signs of a true apostle were manifested among you with all perseverance, in signs, wonders, and miracles.
In what respect were you treated as inferior to the other churches, except that I did not burden you? Forgive me this oversight.

Behold, I am ready to come to you for the third time, and I will not burden you, for I am not seeking your possessions but you. For children ought not to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.
But I will gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more, am I to be loved less?
Nevertheless, I did not burden you. Yet, being prudent, I caught you by deceit.
I did not take advantage of you through any of those whom I sent, did I?
I urged Titus to go, and I sent another brother with him. Titus did not exploit you, did he? Did we not walk in the same Spirit? Did we not follow the same steps?
You have thought all along that we were defending ourselves to you. But we speak in Christ before God, and all things, beloved, are for your spiritual upbuilding.

For I fear that, when I come, I may not find you such as I desire, and you may find me such as you do not desire—lest there be quarreling, jealousy, fits of anger, rivalries, slanders, arrogance, and disorderly conduct.

Lest, when I come again, my God may humble me before you, and I may mourn over many of those who have sinned previously and have not repented of the impurity, sexual immorality, and sensuality they have practiced.

verses.heading: Final Warnings / Final Warnings
verses.text: This is the third time I am coming to you. As the Scriptures say, “Every matter must be confirmed by the testimony of two or three witnesses.”*

I have told you before, and I am saying it again in advance—just as when I was present the second time, and now while I am absent—to those who have sinned previously and to all the rest, that if I come again, I will not show leniency.
You are seeking proof that Christ, who is not weak toward you but powerful among you, is truly speaking through me.
For He was crucified in weakness, yet He lives by the power of God. Likewise, we are weak in Him, yet we will live with Him by the power of God directed toward you.
Examine yourselves to determine whether you are truly in the faith; test yourselves! Do you not know that Jesus Christ is in you—unless you are unapproved?
But I trust that you will recognize that we are not unapproved.
Now we pray to God that you will do nothing wrong—not so that we may appear approved, but so that you may do what is right, even if we appear unapproved.
For we have no authority to act against the truth, but only in support of the truth.
For we rejoice when we are weak, while you are strong; and this is our prayer: that you may reach perfection or maturity.

That is why I am writing these things while I am absent, so that when I come, I may not need to deal harshly with you, according to the authority the Lord has given me—for building up, not tearing down.

verses.heading: Final Greetings / Final Greetings
verses.text: Finally, brothers, rejoice; strive for perfection or maturity; be comforted; be unified in mind; be at peace. And the God of love and of peace will be with you.
Greet one another with a holy kiss.
All the saints send greetings to you.

verses.heading: Notes / Notes
verses.text: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you. 1 Quoted from Deut. 19:15; cf. Num. 35:30

verses.heading: Apostolic Greeting / Apostolic Greeting
verses.text: Paul, an apostle, not appointed by human beings nor commissioned through human mediation, but commissioned through Jesus Christ and God the Father, the One who brought Him back from the dead,
together with all the brothers and sisters who are with me, To the churches throughout Galatia:
May grace or undeserved favor and peace be given to you from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ,
who willingly handed Himself over on behalf of our sins in order to deliver us from the power of this present corrupt age, in harmony with the purposeful will of our God and Father,
to whom honor belongs without end. Amen.

verses.heading: Apostatizing to a Different “Gospel” / Apostatizing to a Different “Gospel”
verses.text: I am astonished that you are abandoning so quickly the One who summoned you by the gracious work of Christ and are turning toward something presented as a different gospel,
even though it does not truly exist as another message of good news. Rather, certain people are unsettling you and are attempting to distort the message concerning Christ.
But even if we ourselves, or a heavenly messenger, were to proclaim a message that contradicts the good news we previously announced to you, that one must be placed under divine judgment.
Just as we have stated before, so I repeat now: If anyone is announcing to you a message that stands in opposition to what you originally received, that one must be condemned.
For whose approval am I seeking now, that of people or that of God? Or am I attempting to satisfy people? If my aim were still to win human approval, I would not be serving Christ as His bondservant.

verses.heading: Paul’s Calling / Paul’s Calling
verses.text: For I want you to understand, brothers and sisters, that the good news I proclaimed does not originate from human reasoning.
I did not receive it from any person, nor was I instructed in it by human teachers; rather, it came through a direct unveiling of Jesus Christ.
You have heard about my former way of life within Judaism, how I relentlessly persecuted the church of God and sought to annihilate it.
I was progressing in Jewish tradition beyond many of my contemporaries among my people, driven by an intense devotion to the ancestral traditions passed down to me.
But when God, who had set me apart before my birth and summoned me through His grace, was pleased
to disclose His Son within me so that I might proclaim Him among the Gentiles, I did not immediately seek counsel from mere human sources,
nor did I travel to Jerusalem to consult those who were apostles before me. Instead, I went away to Arabia and later returned to Damascus.
Then, after three years had passed, I went up to Jerusalem to become personally acquainted with Cephas, and I remained with him for fifteen days.
I did not see any of the other apostles, except James, the Lord’s brother.
In what I am writing to you, I affirm before God that I am speaking truthfully.
After that, I went into the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
I was still unknown by sight to the churches of Judea that belong to Christ.
They only kept hearing it said, “The one who once persecuted us is now proclaiming the faith he formerly tried to destroy.”
And as a result, they were giving glory to God because of what He had done in me.

verses.heading: The Acceptance of Paul by the Apostles / The Acceptance of Paul by the Apostles
verses.text: Then, after a span of fourteen years, I went up again to Jerusalem, accompanied by Barnabas, and I also brought Titus with us.

I went in response to a divine disclosure, and I laid before them the message of good news that I proclaim among the Gentiles. I did this privately with those recognized as leaders, in order to be certain that my labor, past or present, would not prove to be fruitless.
Yet not even Titus, who was with me and who is a Greek, was forced to submit to circumcision.

This matter arose because of false brothers and sisters who had been secretly introduced, who slipped in to observe the freedom we have in Christ Jesus, with the intent of reducing us again to bondage.
We did not give in to them or yield our ground, not even briefly, so that the truth of the gospel would remain intact for you.

As for those who were regarded as influential, whatever their standing once was makes no difference to me, since God does not evaluate people by outward status. Those recognized as leaders contributed nothing further to my message.
Instead, when they recognized that I had been entrusted with the good news for the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been entrusted with the good news for the circumcised,
for the same God who was powerfully at work in Peter for his mission to the circumcised was also at work in me for my mission to the Gentiles,

and when James, Cephas, and John, who were acknowledged as pillars, perceived the grace that had been given to me, they extended to Barnabas and to me the right hand of fellowship. This signified that we should go to the Gentiles, while they would go to the circumcised.
They made this one request, that we would keep the poor in mind, which was precisely what I was eager to do.

verses.heading: Paul Confronts Peter / Paul Confronts Peter
verses.text: But when Cephas came to Antioch, I opposed him directly, because his conduct stood condemned.
Before certain people arrived from James, he had been eating with the Gentiles. But when they came, he began to draw back and separate himself, fearing those who insisted on circumcision.
The rest of the Jews joined him in this pretense, with the result that even Barnabas was led astray by their hypocrisy.

When I saw that their behavior was not aligned with the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas in front of everyone, “If you, though you are a Jew, live like a Gentile and not like a Jew, how can you compel the Gentiles to live as Jews?”

verses.heading: Justification through Faith / Justification through Faith
verses.text: We are Jews by birth and not sinners from among the Gentiles;

yet we know that a man is not justified or declared righteous by performing the works required by the Law, but through faith in Jesus Christ. For this reason, we also have placed our faith in Christ Jesus, so that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the Law, because no human being will be justified by works of the Law.
But if, while seeking to be justified or declared righteous in Christ, we ourselves are found to be sinners, does that make Christ a promoter of sin? Absolutely not.
For if I reconstruct the system I once dismantled, I demonstrate that I am a lawbreaker.
For through the Law I died to the Law, so that I might live for God.

I have been put to death with Christ, and I no longer live for myself; rather, Christ lives within me. And the life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and willingly gave Himself for me.
I do not nullify the grace of God, for if righteousness comes through the Law, then Christ’s death had no purpose.

verses.heading: By Works of the Law, or By Hearing with Faith? / By Works of the Law, or By Hearing with Faith?
verses.text: You foolish Galatians, who has deceived you, when before your very eyes Jesus Christ was publicly presented as crucified?
This is the one thing I want to learn from you: Did you receive the Spirit by performing the works demanded by the Law, or by listening to the message with faith?
Are you truly so senseless? Having begun your life with God by the Spirit, are you now attempting to reach completion by human effort?
Have you experienced so much for no purpose, if indeed it has been for no purpose?
So then, does the One who supplies the Spirit to you and performs mighty works among you do so because you keep the Law, or because you hear and respond in faith?
In the same way, Abraham trusted God, and that trust was credited to him as righteousness.
Therefore, recognize that those who exercise faith are the sons of Abraham.
And the Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify or declare the Gentiles righteous by faith, announced the good news beforehand to Abraham: “In you all the nations will be blessed.”*
As a result, those who belong to faith are blessed along with Abraham, the believer.

verses.heading: The Righteous Shall Live by Faith / The Righteous Shall Live by Faith
verses.text: For all who rely on the works of the Law place themselves under a curse, because it is written: “Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the book of the Law.”*
It is clear that no one is justified or declared righteous before God by means of the Law, because “The righteous one shall live by faith.”*
The Law, however, does not operate on the principle of faith; rather, “The one who practices them shall live by them.”*
Christ rescued us from the curse pronounced by the Law by taking that curse upon Himself, for it is written: “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”*
so that in Christ Jesus the blessing promised to Abraham might extend to the Gentiles, and so that through faith we might receive the promised Spirit.

verses.heading: The Law and the Promise / The Law and the Promise
verses.text: Brothers and sisters, I am speaking in familiar human terms: even a covenant established by human agreement, once confirmed, cannot be annulled or amended.
Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. The wording does not say, “and to seeds,” as though referring to many, but rather to one: “and to your seed,”* who is Christ.
What I am saying is this: The Law, which came four hundred and thirty years later, does not cancel a covenant previously confirmed by God, so as to invalidate the promise.
For if the inheritance is based on the Law, it is no longer based on a promise; but God graciously granted it to Abraham through a promise.
Why then was the Law given? It was added because of transgressions, until the Seed to whom the promise was made should come. It was put into effect through angels by the hand of a mediator.
Now a mediator does not represent only one party, but God is one.
Is the Law, then, opposed to the promises of God? Absolutely not. For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would indeed come through the Law.
But the Scripture has confined everything under the power of sin, so that what was promised, being based on faith in Jesus Christ, might be given to those who believe.
Before faith came, we were held in custody under the Law, confined until the faith that was to be revealed arrived.
In this way, the Law served as our guardian, leading us to Christ, so that we might be justified or declared righteous by faith.
But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian.
For you are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
For all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.
There is neither Jew nor Greek, neither slave nor free, there is no male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

verses.heading: Notes / Notes
verses.text: And if you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s seed, heirs according to promise. 8 Quoted from Gen. 12:3 10 Quoted from Deut. 27:26 11 Quoted from Hab. 2:4 12 Quoted from Lev. 18:5 13 Quoted from Deut. 21:23 16 Quoted from Gen. 12:7; 13:15

verses.heading: Sons and Heirs / Sons and Heirs
verses.text: I say this: As long as the heir is a child, he is in no way different from a slave, even though he owns everything.
He is under guardians and stewards until the time set by his father.
In the same way, we were children, enslaved under the basic principles of the world.
But when the full time had come, God sent His Son, born of a woman and born under the Law,
in order to redeem those under the Law, so that we might receive the adoption as sons.
Because you are sons, God sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, crying out, “Abba! Father!”
Therefore, you are no longer a slave but a son, and if a son, then also an heir through God.

verses.heading: Paul’s Concern for the Galatians / Paul’s Concern for the Galatians
verses.text: At that time, when you did not know God, you were enslaved to things that are not gods by nature.
But now, having come to know God—or rather, having been known by God—how can you turn back to the weak and worthless basic principles, to which you want to submit yourselves again?
You observe days, months, seasons, and years.
I am afraid for you, brothers and sisters, that my labor on your behalf has been in vain.
I urge you, brothers and sisters, become like me, for I have become like you. You have done me no wrong.
You know that it was because of a bodily weakness that I first preached the gospel to you.
You did not despise or reject the trial of my physical condition, but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus Himself.
Where then is your blessing? I testify to you that if it were possible, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me!
So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
They are eager for you, but not for good; they want to exclude you so that you may be eager for them.
It is good to be zealous in a noble cause, and not only when I am present with you.
My children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is fully formed in you!
I wish I could be present with you now and change my tone, because I am deeply perplexed about you.

verses.heading: Hagar and Sarah / Hagar and Sarah
verses.text: Tell me, those of you who desire to live under the Law, do you not listen to what the Law says?
For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and one by the free woman.
The son of the slave woman was born according to human descent, but the son of the free woman was born through the promise.
These things are allegorical: The two women represent two covenants. One covenant is from Mount Sinai, bearing children for slavery, which is Hagar.
Hagar corresponds to Mount Sinai in Arabia and represents the present Jerusalem, because she and her children are in slavery.
But the Jerusalem above is free; she is our mother.

For it is written: “Rejoice, O barren one who does not bear; burst out and shout, you who do not experience the pains of childbirth, because many are the children of the desolate one, more than those of the one who has a husband.”*
Now you, brothers and sisters, are children of promise, like Isaac.
But just as the one born according to the flesh persecuted the one born according to the Spirit at that time, so it is now.
However, what does the Scripture say? “Expel the slave woman and her son, for the son of the slave woman will never share the inheritance with the son of the free woman.”*

verses.heading: Notes / Notes
verses.text: Therefore, brothers and sisters, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman. 27 Quoted from Is. 54:1 30 Quoted from Gen. 21:10

verses.heading: The Liberty Given by Christ / The Liberty Given by Christ
verses.text: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, therefore, and do not submit again to a yoke of slavery.
Look! I, Paul, tell you that if you accept circumcision, Christ will benefit you nothing.
I again testify to every man who chooses circumcision that he is obligated to obey the entire Law.
You who are seeking to be justified or declared righteous by the Law have separated yourselves from Christ; you have fallen from grace.
For through the Spirit, we eagerly wait by faith for the hope of righteousness.
For in Christ Jesus, neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value, but only faith working through love.
You were running a good race. Who hindered you from obeying the truth?
This persuasion does not come from the One who calls you.
A little yeast spreads through the whole batch of dough.
I am confident in you, brothers and sisters, that you will remain steadfast in the Lord, and the one troubling you will face judgment, whoever he may be.
Brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case, the offense of the cross has been nullified.
I wish that those upsetting you would go so far as to mutilate themselves!
For you were called to freedom, brothers and sisters. Only do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but rather, through love, serve one another.
For the entire Law is fulfilled in this one command: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you are not consumed by each other.

verses.heading: Walking by the Spirit and Aligning with the Spirit / Walking by the Spirit and Aligning with the Spirit
verses.text: I say this: Live by the Spirit, and you will never fulfill the desire of the flesh.
For the flesh desires what is opposed to the Spirit, and the Spirit desires what is opposed to the flesh. They are in conflict with each other, so that you are unable to do what you desire.
But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the Law.
Now the works of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, sensual indulgence,
idolatry, sorcery, hostilities, strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, selfish ambitions, rivalries, divisions,
envy, drunkenness, orgies, and the like—I am warning you, as I warned you before, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
gentleness and self-control. Against such qualities there is no law.
Those who belong to Christ Jesus have put the flesh to death, along with its passions and desires.
Since we live by the Spirit, let us also follow the Spirit’s guidance.
Let us not become conceited, provoking one another, or envying one another.

verses.heading: Bearing One Another’s Burdens / Bearing One Another’s Burdens
verses.text: Brothers and sisters, if a man is caught in any sin, you who are spiritual should restore him gently, being careful to watch yourself, so that you are not also tempted.
Carry one another’s burdens, and in doing so, you will fulfill the law of Christ.
For if anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
Let each one examine his own actions, and then he will have cause for pride in himself alone, and not in comparison with others.
For each one will bear his own responsibility.

verses.heading: Sowing to the Spirit / Sowing to the Spirit
verses.text: Let the one who is taught the message share all good things with the one who teaches.
Do not be deceived: God cannot be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will also reap.
Those who sow to satisfy their flesh will reap decay from the flesh, but those who sow to the Spirit will reap eternal life from the Spirit.
Let us not grow weary in doing good, for in due time we will reap if we do not give up.
Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all people, especially to those who belong to the household of faith.

verses.heading: The Superiority of the New Creation Over Circumcision and Uncircumcision / The Superiority of the New Creation Over Circumcision and Uncircumcision
verses.text: See the large letters in which I have written this with my own hand!
All who desire to make a favorable impression on the flesh—these people are insisting on circumcision—do so only to avoid persecution for the cross of Christ.
For not even those who are circumcised obey the Law themselves; yet they want you circumcised so that they may boast in your flesh.
But may it never be that I should boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value; what matters is being a new creation.
Peace and mercy be upon all who follow this rule, and upon the Israel of God.

verses.heading: Conclusion and Benediction / Conclusion and Benediction
verses.text: From now on, let no one cause trouble for me, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.
May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

verses.heading: Apostolic Greeting / Apostolic Greeting
verses.text: Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus through the sovereign will of God, To God’s consecrated people living in Ephesus, those who remain steadfast in their union with Christ Jesus:
May grace or undeserved favor and peace be yours from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.heading: Ascription of Praise to God / Ascription of Praise to God
verses.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has lavished upon us every spiritual gift from the heavenly realm through our union with Christ.
He chose us to belong to Christ before the world was created, with the intention that we would live in holiness and without fault in His presence, motivated by love.
He determined beforehand that we would be brought into His family as His sons and daughters through Jesus Christ, fulfilling His own gracious intention and desire,
all for the purpose of bringing praise to His magnificent grace, which He has generously bestowed on us through His beloved Son.
Through Him we have been liberated through His sacrificial blood, receiving forgiveness for our violations of God’s Law, in keeping with the abundant wealth of His grace,
which He poured out upon us with complete wisdom and spiritual insight.
God revealed to us the hidden purpose of His will, in accordance with His gracious plan that He determined in Christ
to be carried out when the fullness of the appointed times unfolds—namely, to bring everything together under Christ’s headship—all things in heaven and all things on earth—yes, in Him alone.

In Christ we have also received our appointed inheritance, having been chosen beforehand according to the predetermined plan of the One who accomplishes all things in harmony with the decision of His will,
so that we who were the first to place our hope in Christ would live for the praise of His magnificent character.
In Him you also were included when you heard the message of truth—the good news of your salvation—and having placed your trust in Him, you were marked with the seal of the promised Holy Spirit,
who serves as the down payment guaranteeing our inheritance until God fully redeems those who are His own possession, resulting in praise to His glory.

verses.heading: Pauline Prayer for the Gift of the Spirit of Wisdom and Revelation / Pauline Prayer for the Gift of the Spirit of Wisdom and Revelation
verses.text: Because of this, ever since I learned about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all of God’s people,
I have not stopped expressing gratitude for you, continually mentioning you in my prayers.
I pray that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father who possesses all glory, would give you the Spirit who imparts wisdom and revelation, enabling you to know Him more fully.

I pray that the eyes of your heart would be flooded with light, so that you would understand the hope to which He has called you, the glorious wealth of the inheritance He has reserved for His people,
and the immeasurably great power available to us who believe, power that operates according to the working of His overwhelming might.
This is the same mighty strength He exerted in Christ when He raised Him from death and placed Him at His right hand in the heavenly realm,
positioning Him far above every authority and power and force and lordship, and above every title that can be given, not only in this present age but also in the age that is yet to come.
God has placed all things in subjection under His feet and appointed Him as supreme head over everything for the benefit of the church,
which is His body, the fullness of Him who completely fills everything in every way.

verses.heading: Saved By Grace Through Faith / Saved By Grace Through Faith
verses.text: You were spiritually dead because of your transgressions and sins,

the way of life in which you once conducted yourselves, following the pattern of this present world system, under the influence of the ruler who governs the spiritual realm of the air, the spirit who is now actively working in those who are characterized by disobedience to God.

We all once conducted ourselves among them in the cravings of our fallen nature, carrying out the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and we were by our very nature children destined for God’s wrath, just like everyone else.
But God, who has abundant mercy, because of the great love with which He loved us,
even while we were dead in our transgressions, made us alive together with Christ—it is by grace that you have been saved—
and He raised us up together with Him and seated us together with Him in the heavenly realm in Christ Jesus,
in order that in the ages to come He might demonstrate the surpassing riches of His grace expressed in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus.
For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this salvation is not something that originates from yourselves; it is God’s gift to you,
not something earned by works, so that no one has grounds for boasting.
For we are His creative masterpiece, created in Christ Jesus to live out the good works that God prepared in advance for us to walk in.

verses.heading: Unity of the Jewish and Gentile Saints in Christ Jesus / Unity of the Jewish and Gentile Saints in Christ Jesus
verses.text: Therefore, remember that formerly you who are Gentiles by physical birth—referred to as “the uncircumcised” by those who call themselves “the circumcised” because of a physical operation performed by human hands—

recall that at that time you existed apart from Christ, excluded from citizenship in Israel, and foreigners to the covenants that contained God’s promise, living without hope and without God in the world.
But now in Christ Jesus, you who were once distant have been brought near through the blood of Christ.
For He Himself is our peace, the One who made both groups into one and demolished the dividing wall, the hostility, through His physical death,
by rendering powerless the Law with its commandments expressed in regulations, so that in Himself He might create one new humanity out of the two groups, thereby establishing peace,
and might reconcile both groups to God in one body through the cross, having put to death the hostility through Himself.
Then He came and proclaimed the good news of peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.
For through Him we both have access by one Spirit to come into the Father’s presence.
Consequently, you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with God’s people and members of God’s household,
built on the foundation laid by the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone,
in whom the entire structure, being joined together, continues to grow into a holy sanctuary in the Lord,
in whom you also are being constructed together into a dwelling place where God lives by the Spirit.

verses.heading: The Revelation of the Mystery of Christ / The Revelation of the Mystery of Christ
verses.text: For this reason, I, Paul, am a prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles—
if indeed, you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace that was entrusted to me for your benefit,
that the mystery was made known to me through direct revelation, just as I briefly wrote previously.
By reading this, you will be able to perceive my understanding of the mystery concerning Christ,
which was not made known to people in past generations as it has now been revealed to His holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit:
specifically, that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the same body and fellow participants in the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel,
of which I became a servant according to the gift of God’s grace given to me through the operation of His power.
To me, though I am the least significant of all God’s people, this grace was granted: to proclaim to the Gentiles the unfathomable riches found in Christ,
and to make clear to everyone what is the plan of the mystery that was hidden throughout past ages in God who created all things,
so that now through the church the multifaceted wisdom of God might be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,
according to the eternal purpose that He carried out in Christ Jesus our Lord,
in whom we possess bold confidence and the privilege of approaching God with assurance through faith in Him.
Therefore I ask you not to become discouraged because of my sufferings on your behalf, which actually bring honor to you.

verses.heading: Pauline Prayer for Attaining to All the Fullness of God / Pauline Prayer for Attaining to All the Fullness of God
verses.text: For this reason I kneel before the Father,
from whom every family in heaven and on earth receives its identity,
asking that He would grant you, according to the riches of His glory, to be strengthened with power through His Spirit in your inner being,
so that Christ would make His home in your hearts through faith, and that you, being firmly rooted and established in love,
would have the strength to grasp fully, along with all the saints, what is the breadth and length and height and depth of God’s love,
and to experientially grasp the love of Christ—a love that transcends human understanding—so that you may be filled to all the fullness of God.
Now to the One who has the power to accomplish infinitely beyond all things we request or conceive, working through His mighty power that operates within us,
to Him belongs all glory in the church and in Christ Jesus through every generation, for all eternity. Amen.

verses.heading: Unity in the Body of Christ / Unity in the Body of Christ
verses.text: I therefore, as a prisoner because of my service to the Lord, urge you to conduct your lives in a way that reflects the high calling you have received,
demonstrating complete humility and gentleness, with patient endurance, showing tolerance toward one another in love,
making every effort to preserve the unity that the Spirit creates through the bond of peace.
There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope when God called you—
one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
one God and Father of all people, who rules over all and works through all and dwells in all.
Yet to each individual among us grace has been given in proportion to the measure of Christ’s gift.
This is why Scripture says, “When He ascended to the heights, He took captives in His train; He distributed gifts to people.”*
(Now this reference to His ascension implies that He also descended into the lower regions, the earth itself.
He who descended is the very same One who ascended far above all the heavens, in order to fill the entire universe.)
So He personally gave the apostles, and the prophets, and the evangelists, and the pastors and teachers,
for the purpose of equipping God’s people for works of service, so that the body of Christ would be built up,
until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, arriving at mature manhood, measured by nothing less than the full stature of Christ.

Then we will no longer be immature children, shaken and tossed by the waves and swept along by every changing wind of teaching—by human cleverness and by craftiness deliberately designed to lead us progressively into error.
Instead, by speaking the truth in love, we are to grow up in every way into Him who is the head, namely Christ,
from whom the entire body, joined and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love as each part does its work according to its proper function.

verses.heading: Living the New Life in Christ / Living the New Life in Christ
verses.text: So I declare this and solemnly affirm it in the Lord: You must no longer live as the Gentiles live, in the emptiness of their reasoning,
having their understanding darkened, being separated from the life of God because of the ignorance within them, which stems from the hardness of their hearts.
They have lost all moral sensitivity and have abandoned themselves to sensuality, engaging in every form of impurity with an insatiable desire for more.
But you did not learn Christ in this way—
surely you heard about Him and were taught in Him, in accordance with the truth that is found in Jesus:
that you must put off your former way of life, the old self that is being corrupted by its deceitful lusts;
that you must be renewed in the attitude of your mind,
and put on the new self, which God has created in conformity to His own character—marked by righteousness and holiness that arise from the truth.
Therefore, having laid aside falsehood, each one must speak truthfully with his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.
If you become angry, do not let it lead you into sin; do not let the sun set while you are still angry,
and do not give the devil an opportunity.
The person who has been stealing must steal no longer; rather, he must work hard, doing honest labor with his own hands, so that he will have something to share with anyone in need.
Allow no corrupting words to come from your mouth, but speak only what is beneficial for edifying others as the situation requires, so that your words will impart grace to those who hear.
And do not cause grief to God’s Holy Spirit, who has marked you with His seal until the day when your redemption is complete.
Remove from your lives all bitterness, fury and rage, all brawling and verbal abuse, together with every kind of malicious intent.

verses.heading: Notes / Notes
verses.text: Rather, show kindness and tender hearts toward one another, extending forgiveness to each other in the same way God extended forgiveness to you through Christ. 8 Quoted from Ps. 68:18

verses.heading: Imitating God / Imitating God
verses.text: Therefore, pattern your lives after God, as children who are deeply loved by Him,
and conduct yourselves in love, following the example of Christ who loved us and offered Himself on our behalf as a sacrificial offering to God, producing a pleasing fragrance.
But sexual immorality and every form of moral impurity or greediness must not even be mentioned among you, as befits those who belong to God—
likewise, vulgar speech, empty babbling, or crude humor, which are inappropriate, but let thanksgiving characterize your speech instead.
For you know with certainty that no person who is sexually immoral, morally impure, or greedy—which amounts to idolatry—possesses any inheritance in the kingdom that belongs to Christ and God.
Do not allow anyone to mislead you with hollow reasoning, for God’s wrath falls upon the disobedient because of these very things.
Therefore, do not associate yourselves with such people as their partners.

verses.heading: Light in the Lord / Light in the Lord
verses.text: For at one time you yourselves were darkness, but now you exist as light in the Lord. Conduct yourselves as those who belong to the light
(for the light produces fruit that consists of complete goodness, righteousness and truth),
carefully examining what brings pleasure to the Lord.
Take no part in the barren works that belong to darkness, but instead bring them into the open.
For even to speak of what they practice in hiding brings shame.
But when anything is brought into the open by the light, it becomes visible and clear, for whatever makes things visible is light.
Therefore it says, “Awaken, you who sleep, and rise up from among the dead, and Christ will give you light.”*
Pay careful attention, therefore, to how you conduct your lives—not as those lacking wisdom but as those who possess it,
seizing every opportunity wisely, for the times are characterized by evil.
For this reason, do not lack in understanding, but grasp what the Lord desires.

verses.heading: Results of Being Filled with the Spirit / Results of Being Filled with the Spirit
verses.text: Do not become intoxicated with wine, for that path leads to debauchery; rather, keep being filled with the Spirit,
speaking to each other through psalms and hymns and songs inspired by the Spirit, singing and making melodies in your hearts directed to the Lord,
continually expressing gratitude to God the Father for everything, doing so in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,
yielding to one another in reverent fear of Christ:
Wives, yield to your own husbands as an expression of your submission to the Lord,
because the husband functions as head over the wife in the same way that Christ functions as head over the church, being Himself the deliverer of the body.
Now just as the church places itself under Christ’s authority, so wives should place themselves under their husbands’ authority in all matters.
Husbands, demonstrate love toward your wives in the same manner that Christ demonstrated love toward the church and surrendered Himself on her behalf
in order to consecrate her, having purified her through the cleansing that comes by water accompanied by the spoken word,
so that He could present the church to Himself in splendor, having neither blemish nor wrinkle nor anything of that kind, but rather that she would be consecrated and without defect.
Husbands ought to demonstrate love toward their own wives in this same manner, treating them as their own bodies. The man who demonstrates love toward his wife demonstrates love toward himself.
For no person has ever despised his own flesh, but rather provides nourishment for it and cares for it tenderly, just as Christ does for the church—
because we are parts of His body.
“For this cause a man shall depart from his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh.”*
This mystery holds great significance—I am applying it to Christ and the church.

verses.heading: Notes / Notes
verses.text: In any case, each individual husband among you must love his own wife as he loves himself, and the wife must show reverence for her husband. 14 The source of this quote is unknown, but there are allusions to several Old Testament texts of Is. 26:19; 51:17; 52:1; 60:1; Mal. 4:2 31 Quoted from Gen. 2:24

verses.heading: Children and Parents / Children and Parents
verses.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this represents right conduct.
“Give honor to your father and mother”—this is the first commandment that carries a promise with it—
“in order that things may go well for you and that you may live many years on the earth.”
And fathers, do not exasperate your children, but raise them with the discipline and guidance that come from the Lord.

verses.heading: Slaves and Masters / Slaves and Masters
verses.text: Slaves, render obedience to those who are your masters in the physical realm, approaching them with fear and trembling and with genuine sincerity of heart, as though serving Christ Himself,
not merely when they are watching you and in order to gain their approval, but as those who serve Christ, accomplishing God’s will from the depths of your being.
Carry out your service with eager willingness, as though rendering it to the Lord rather than to human beings,
understanding that each person will receive back from the Lord whatever good deed he performs, whether he is a slave or a free person.
And masters, demonstrate the same attitude toward them, ceasing from threats, recognizing that the One who is Master over both them and you resides in heaven, and with Him there exists no partiality.

verses.heading: The Complete Armor of God / The Complete Armor of God
verses.text: Finally, draw your strength from the Lord and from the power of His overwhelming might.
Clothe yourselves with the complete equipment that God provides, enabling you to hold your position against the deceptive strategies of the devil.

For the battle we fight is not directed against human opponents, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the world powers governing this present darkness, against the spiritual forces that promote evil in the heavenly realm.

Because of this, take up the complete equipment that God provides, so that you will have the ability to resist when the evil day arrives, and having accomplished everything necessary, to remain standing.
Take your stand, then, having fastened the belt of truth around your waist, having clothed yourself with the breastplate that righteousness provides,
having strapped on your feet the readiness that the gospel of peace supplies.
Beyond all these things, take hold of the shield that faith provides, by means of which you will have the power to extinguish every flaming arrow that the evil one launches.
Accept the helmet that salvation provides and the sword that the Spirit supplies, which is God’s spoken word.
Through every kind of prayer and petition, pray at all times in the Spirit, and toward this end remain vigilant with complete persistence and petition on behalf of all who are God’s people.
Pray also on my behalf, that the right message would be given to me whenever I open my mouth, enabling me to proclaim fearlessly the hidden truth of the gospel,
for which I serve as an ambassador, though I am bound with chains. Pray that in proclaiming it I would speak with the boldness that my duty requires.

verses.heading: Final Greetings and Benediction / Final Greetings and Benediction
verses.text: Now in order that you may also have knowledge of my circumstances and what I am doing, Tychicus, my beloved brother and dependable servant in the Lord, will provide you with all the information.
I have sent him to you for this precise purpose, that you might learn about our situation and that he might bring encouragement to your hearts.
Peace to the brothers and sisters, along with love combined with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
May grace be present with all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an uncorrupted and enduring love.

verses.heading: Apostolic Greeting / Apostolic Greeting
verses.text: Paul and Timothy, bondservants wholly devoted to Christ Jesus, To all of God’s consecrated people in Christ Jesus who are living in Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:
May grace or undeserved favor and peace be yours from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.heading: Pauline Thanksgiving / Pauline Thanksgiving
verses.text: I express gratitude to my God every time I bring you to mind,
constantly in every petition I make on behalf of all of you, offering my petition with delight,
on account of your partnership in advancing the gospel from the very first day until this present moment,
holding firmly to this conviction: that He who initiated a good work among you will bring it to completion by the day of Christ Jesus.

It is entirely appropriate for me to have this perspective about all of you, because you hold a place in my heart, since all of you share with me in grace, both during my chains and in the vindication and establishment of the gospel.
For God serves as my witness of how deeply I long for all of you with the tender affections that belong to Christ Jesus.

verses.heading: Pauline Prayer / Pauline Prayer
verses.text: And this is what I pray: that your love would continue to abound more and more in genuine knowledge and complete insight,
enabling you to discern what is excellent, so that you would be pure and without offense for the day of Christ,
having been filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, resulting in glory and praise to God.

verses.heading: The Furtherance of the Gospel / The Furtherance of the Gospel
verses.text: Now I want you to understand, brothers and sisters, that the circumstances surrounding me have actually resulted in the gospel’s advancement,
with the result that my imprisonment for Christ has become widely known throughout the entire imperial guard and to everyone else,
and the majority of the brothers and sisters, having gained confidence in the Lord through my imprisonment, now speak God’s message with greater courage and without fear.
It is true that some are proclaiming Christ from motives of envy and contentiousness, while others do so from genuine goodwill.
These latter ones proclaim Christ from love, understanding that I have been positioned here for the defense of the gospel.
The former group announces Christ from selfish ambition rather than pure motives, supposing they can intensify my suffering in my chains.

But what does it matter? The important thing is that in every manner—whether from false motives or genuine ones—Christ is being proclaimed, and I find joy in this. Indeed, I will continue to find joy,
for I know that this situation will result in my deliverance through your intercession and the generous supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

in keeping with my eager expectation and confident hope that I will not be put to shame in any respect, but that with complete boldness—as has always been the case—Christ will be exalted in my body, whether through my life or through my death.
For in my case, living means Christ, and dying brings gain.
Yet if continuing to live in this physical body means productive labor for me, then I cannot say which I would prefer.
I find myself caught between these two possibilities, having the strong desire to depart this life and be with Christ, which would be vastly superior.
Yet remaining in this physical existence is more essential for your benefit.
Being persuaded of this, I know that I will remain and continue alongside all of you to promote your progress and joy in the faith,
so that your confident boasting in Christ Jesus may increase on account of me when I come to be with you again.

verses.heading: The Faith of the Gospel / The Faith of the Gospel
verses.text: Simply ensure that you conduct yourselves in a manner that reflects the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and observe you personally or remain absent, I may receive reports about your circumstances—that you are standing united in one spirit, striving together with one purpose for the faith that belongs to the gospel,
and not being intimidated in any way by those who oppose you. This serves as evidence of their coming destruction but of your salvation—and this comes from God.
For it has been graciously granted to you on Christ’s behalf not merely to believe in Him, but also to suffer for His sake,
as you undergo the same kind of struggle you witnessed in me and now hear that I continue to experience.

verses.heading: Spiritual Unity / Spiritual Unity
verses.text: Therefore, if there exists any encouragement in Christ, if any consolation flowing from love, if any fellowship created by the Spirit, if any tender compassion and mercy,
complete my joy by maintaining the same mindset, possessing the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.
Do nothing motivated by selfish ambition or empty conceit, but in humility regard others as more important than yourselves.
Each person should be concerned not only with personal interests but also with the interests of others.

verses.heading: The Paradigm of Christ / The Paradigm of Christ
verses.text: Adopt the same attitude that was present in Christ Jesus,
who, though He existed in the very form of God, did not regard His equality with God as something to exploit for His own advantage,
but instead emptied Himself by assuming the form of a slave, being born in human likeness.
And having been recognized in His manner as a man, He humbled Himself by becoming obedient to the point of death—even death on a cross.
For this reason God also highly exalted Him and bestowed on Him the name that stands above every name,
so that at the name of Jesus every knee should bend—in heaven and on earth and beneath the earth—
and every tongue should openly declare that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

verses.heading: Working out of Salvation / Working out of Salvation
verses.text: Therefore, my dear ones, just as you have consistently obeyed, not only during my presence but even more so now during my absence, continue working out your salvation with reverence and trembling.
For it is God who is actively at work within you, producing both the desire and the ability to accomplish His good purpose.
Carry out everything without complaining and disputing,

so that you may prove yourselves to be blameless and innocent, children of God who are above reproach in the midst of a warped and corrupt generation, among whom you appear as luminaries in the world,
holding fast to the message of life, giving me reason for boasting on the day of Christ that I did not run my race pointlessly nor labor without result.
But even if my life is being poured out like a drink offering upon the sacrifice and priestly service of your faith, I am filled with joy, and I share that joy with all of you.
In the same manner, you also should be filled with joy and share that joy with me.

verses.heading: Timothy and Epaphroditus / Timothy and Epaphroditus
verses.text: I am confident in the Lord Jesus that I will be able to send Timothy to you soon, so that I too may be encouraged when I receive information about your circumstances.
For I have no one else with a disposition like his who will genuinely be concerned about your welfare.
For they all pursue their own interests rather than the interests of Jesus Christ.
But you know Timothy’s tested character—how like a son serving alongside his father, he has labored with me in advancing the gospel.
I am hoping, therefore, to send him as soon as I gain clarity about my own situation,
though I am confident in the Lord that I myself will also come to you before long.
However, I have concluded it necessary to send Epaphroditus back to you—my brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier, whom you sent as your representative and servant to address my needs,
since he has been deeply longing to see all of you and was distressed that you heard about his illness.
For indeed he was ill to the point of nearly dying, but God showed mercy to him—and not only to him but also to me—so that I would not experience one sorrow on top of another.
I am sending him back with special urgency, therefore, so that when you see him again you may experience joy, and I may have less anxiety.
Welcome him in the Lord with complete joy, and hold people like him in high honor,
because for the sake of Christ’s work he came close to death, risking his life to provide the service to me that you were unable to give personally.

verses.heading: Confidence in the Righteousness Through Faith in Christ Jesus / Confidence in the Righteousness Through Faith in Christ Jesus
verses.text: Finally, my brothers and sisters, find your joy in the Lord. Writing these same things to you is no burden for me, and it provides protection for you.
Be on guard against the dogs! Be on guard against those who do evil! Be on guard against those who mutilate the flesh!
For we are the true circumcision—we who worship by the Spirit of God and boast in Christ Jesus and place no confidence in human credentials,
though I myself have grounds for confidence even in human credentials. If anyone else presumes to have confidence based on human credentials, I possess even more:
circumcised on the eighth day, belonging to the people of Israel, from the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew descended from Hebrews; regarding the Law, a Pharisee;
regarding zeal, one who persecuted the church; regarding the righteousness found in the Law, blameless.
But whatever things were assets to me, I have come to regard as loss for the sake of Christ.

More than that, I regard everything as loss compared to the surpassing value of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whose sake I have forfeited everything and consider it all as rubbish, in order that I may gain Christ
and be found in Him, not possessing my own righteousness derived from the Law, but the righteousness that comes through faith in Christ—the righteousness from God based on faith—
so that I may know Him and the power of His resurrection and the sharing of His sufferings, being conformed to His death,
hoping that somehow I may attain the resurrection from the dead.

verses.heading: Pressing Forward Toward the Goal / Pressing Forward Toward the Goal
verses.text: Not that I have already obtained this or have already reached perfection, but I press forward to take hold of it because I was also taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
Brothers and sisters, I do not consider that I have already taken hold of it. But this one thing I do: forgetting what lies behind and straining toward what lies ahead,
I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.
Therefore, let all of us who are mature adopt this way of thinking. And if on any point you think differently, God will clarify this for you as well.
Nevertheless, let us live according to the same standard we have already reached.

verses.heading: The Apostolic Pattern / The Apostolic Pattern
verses.text: Brothers and sisters, join together in imitating me, and pay careful attention to those who conduct themselves according to the pattern we have provided for you.
For many people conduct themselves—about whom I have frequently warned you, and now tell you even with tears—as enemies of the cross of Christ.
Their end is destruction, their god is their appetite, and they take pride in their shame—they set their minds on earthly matters.
But our citizenship belongs to heaven, and it is from there we eagerly await a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,
who will transform our lowly bodies to be conformed to His glorious body, according to the power by which He is able to subject all things to Himself.
Therefore, my brothers and sisters whom I love and long for deeply, my joy and crown, continue standing firm in the Lord in this manner, dear ones.

verses.heading: Exhortation to Unity / Exhortation to Unity
verses.text: I urge Euodia and I urge Syntyche to achieve harmony of mind in the Lord.

Yes, I also ask you, my true companion, to assist these women who labored alongside me in spreading the gospel, together with Clement and my other fellow workers, whose names are recorded in the book of life.

verses.heading: Final Exhortations / Final Exhortations
verses.text: Find joy in the Lord always; again I say, find joy.
Let your gracious spirit be evident to all people. The Lord is near.
Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, through prayer and petition accompanied by thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all human understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

Finally, brothers and sisters, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if anything possesses excellence, and if anything deserves praise—focus your thoughts on these things.
Whatever you have learned and received and heard and observed in me—put these things into practice. And the God of peace will be with you.

verses.heading: Contentment in Every Situation / Contentment in Every Situation
verses.text: I experienced great joy in the Lord that now at last you have renewed your concern for me, though you were indeed concerned but lacked opportunity to demonstrate it.
I am not saying this because I am in need, for I have learned to be content in whatever circumstances I find myself.

I know what it is to experience deprivation, and I know what it is to live in abundance. In every circumstance and in all situations, I have learned the secret of both being well-fed and going hungry, both having plenty and experiencing scarcity.
I have strength for all things through Him who empowers me.
Nevertheless, you acted nobly in sharing together with me in my hardship.
You Philippians yourselves also know that in the early period of the gospel ministry, when I left Macedonia, no church entered into partnership with me regarding financial support except you alone;
for even when I was in Thessalonica, you sent assistance for my needs on multiple occasions.
Not that I am seeking the gift itself, but I am seeking the benefit that accumulates to your account.
I have received everything in full and have more than enough. I am amply supplied, having received from Epaphroditus the gifts you sent—a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice that pleases God.
And my God will fully supply every need of yours according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
Now to our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.

verses.heading: Final Greetings and Benediction / Final Greetings and Benediction
verses.text: Greet every one of God’s people in Christ Jesus. The brothers and sisters who are with me send you greetings.
All of God’s people here send you greetings, especially those who belong to Caesar’s household.
May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

verses.heading: Apostolic Greeting / Apostolic Greeting
verses.text: Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus through God’s sovereign will, and Timothy our brother,
To God’s consecrated people and faithful brothers and sisters in Christ who live in Colossae: May grace or unmerited favor and peace be yours from God our Father.

verses.heading: Pauline Thanksgiving and Prayer / Pauline Thanksgiving and Prayer
verses.text: We continually express gratitude to God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, as we pray for you at all times,
since we have received reports about your faith in Christ Jesus and the love you demonstrate toward all of God’s people,
on account of the hope that is being kept safe for you in heaven, about which you previously heard when the message of truth—the gospel—was proclaimed to you.

This gospel has reached you just as it is producing fruit and growing throughout the entire world—and it has been doing the same among you from the day you first heard and truly understood God’s grace,
exactly as you were taught by Epaphras, our dear fellow servant, who serves as a faithful minister of Christ on your behalf,
and who has informed us about your love that flows from the Spirit.
For this reason, we have not ceased praying for you and asking that you would be filled with the knowledge of His will through complete wisdom and spiritual comprehension,
so that you may conduct your lives in a manner that honors the Lord and pleases Him in every respect—bearing fruit through every good work and growing in the knowledge of God,
being empowered with complete strength according to His magnificent might, enabling you to attain total endurance and patience accompanied by joy,
giving thanks to the Father, who has made you qualified to receive your share of the inheritance belonging to God’s people in the realm of light.
He has delivered us from the domain of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son,

verses.heading: The Preeminence of Christ in Redemption and Creation / The Preeminence of Christ in Redemption and Creation
verses.text: in whom we possess redemption, which is the forgiveness of our sins.
He is the visible representation of the invisible God, the firstborn or the supreme One of and over all creation,

for in Him all things were brought into existence—things in heaven and things on earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things have been created through Him and for Him.
He exists prior to all things, and in Him all things hold together in unity.
He is the head of the body, which is the church. He is the origin, the firstborn or the supreme One from among the dead, so that He might occupy first place in everything.
For it pleased God that all His fullness would take up residence in Him,
and through Him to reconcile all things to Himself—having established peace through the blood of His cross—yes, through Him—whether things on earth or things in heaven.
And you, who were once estranged and hostile in your thinking through wicked actions,
He has now reconciled through His physical body by means of death, in order to present you holy and without blemish and above reproach before Him,

provided that you remain in the faith, firmly established and unshaken, not shifting away from the hope proclaimed in the gospel you heard, which has been announced to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.

verses.heading: Purpose of the Sufferings and Ministry of Paul / Purpose of the Sufferings and Ministry of Paul
verses.text: Now I find joy in the sufferings I endure for your benefit, and I am completing in my physical body what remains of Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church.
I became a servant of the church according to the responsibility God gave me for your benefit: to bring God’s word to its full expression,
the mystery that was concealed throughout past ages and generations but has now been revealed to His consecrated people.
God determined to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery—which is Christ dwelling in you, your confident hope of glory.
We proclaim Him, warning every person and instructing every person with complete wisdom, so that we may present every person as perfect or fully mature in Christ.
For this purpose I labor strenuously, contending according to His power that works mightily within me.

verses.heading: Christ, the Mystery of God / Christ, the Mystery of God
verses.text: For I want you to understand how intensely I am laboring on behalf of you and those in Laodicea and all who have not met me personally,

so that their hearts would be strengthened, being united together in love, and that they would reach the complete wealth that comes from full conviction of understanding, resulting in the knowledge of God’s mystery—which is Christ—
in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge lie concealed.
I am telling you this so that no one will mislead you with persuasive arguments.
For although I am physically absent, I am nevertheless with you in spirit, finding joy as I observe your disciplined manner of life and the solid foundation of your faith in Christ.

verses.heading: The Fullness of the Deity Dwelling in Christ / The Fullness of the Deity Dwelling in Christ
verses.text: Therefore, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue living in union with Him,
having been rooted and being continually built up in Him and strengthened in the faith just as you were instructed, overflowing in thanksgiving.
Be careful that no one takes you captive through philosophy and deceptive emptiness based on human tradition, based on the elementary principles that govern the world, rather than based on Christ.
For in Him the complete fullness of deity resides in bodily form.
And you have been brought to completion in Him, who is the supreme head over every ruler and authority.
In Him you also received a circumcision performed without human hands, through the removal of the body dominated by the flesh, through the circumcision that belongs to Christ.
You were buried with Him in baptism, through which you were also raised with Him through faith in the powerful working of God, who raised Him from death.
When you were dead in your transgressions and in the uncircumcised state of your flesh, He made you alive together with Him, having forgiven us all our transgressions.
He erased the written record of indebtedness that consisted of regulations that stood against us and were hostile to us, and He removed it completely by nailing it to the cross.
After disarming the rulers and authorities, He displayed them publicly as conquered, having triumphed over them through Him.

verses.heading: Holding Fast to Christ / Holding Fast to Christ
verses.text: Therefore, do not allow anyone to pass judgment on you regarding food or drink, or concerning a feast or new moon celebration or Sabbath observance.
These are merely a shadow of what was coming, but the substance belongs to Christ.
Let no one declare you disqualified by insisting on false humility and angel worship, dwelling on visions he claims to have seen, being groundlessly arrogant because of his unspiritual mindset,
and failing to maintain connection with the Head, from whom the entire body, being supplied and held together through its joints and ligaments, experiences the growth that comes from God.
If you died with Christ to the elementary principles of the world, why do you live as though you still belonged to the world by submitting to regulations:
“Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch”
(all these prohibitions refer to things destined to perish with use)—based on human commands and teachings?

These regulations have an outward appearance of wisdom through self-directed religious practices and false humility and severe treatment of the body, but they possess no value in restraining indulgence of the flesh.

verses.heading: Raised with Christ / Raised with Christ
verses.text: Therefore, since you have been raised to new life with Christ, direct your pursuit toward the things above, where Christ is, seated at God’s right hand.
Keep your minds focused on the things above, not on earthly matters.
For you have died, and your life is now concealed with Christ in God.
When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.

verses.heading: New Life in Christ / New Life in Christ
verses.text: Put to death, therefore, the earthly nature within you: sexual immorality, moral impurity, lustful passion, evil craving, and greed, which amounts to idolatry.
Because of these practices, God's wrath is coming upon those characterized by disobedience.
You once conducted yourselves in these ways when you were living in that manner.
But now you must also rid yourselves of all such things: anger, rage, malicious intent, slander, and obscene language from your mouth.
Do not lie to one another, since you have stripped off the old self along with its practices,
and have clothed yourselves with the new self that is being progressively renewed in knowledge according to the image of the One who created it.
In this new reality there is no distinction between Greek and Jew, circumcised and uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free person; rather, Christ is everything and is in everyone.
Therefore, clothe yourselves as God’s chosen ones, holy and dearly loved, with compassionate hearts, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience,
bearing with one another and extending forgiveness to each other. If anyone has a grievance against another, just as the Lord forgave you, you must do the same.
And above all these qualities, clothe yourselves with love, which binds everything together in perfect harmony.
Let the peace of Christ, to which you were indeed called as members of one body, govern your hearts; and cultivate gratitude.
