Let the word of Christ dwell among you abundantly, teaching and admonishing one another in all wisdom through psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing to God with thankfulness in your hearts.
And whatever you do, whether in word or action, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus, expressing thanks to God the Father through Him.

verses.heading: Christian Relationships / Christian Relationships
verses.text: Wives are to live in respectful submission to their husbands, as is appropriate for those who belong to the Lord.
Husbands are to love their wives and avoid harshness or bitterness toward them.
Children are to obey their parents in all things, since this delights the Lord.
Fathers must not embitter their children, or they will become discouraged.
Slaves, obey your earthly masters in all matters—not only when they are watching, as those who seek to please people, but with sincerity of heart, fearing the Lord.
Whatever you do, work at it wholeheartedly, as serving the Lord rather than serving people,
knowing that you will receive an inheritance as your reward from the Lord. Continue serving the Lord Christ.
For the person who does wrong will be repaid for the wrong committed, and there is no partiality.
Masters, provide what is fair and equitable to your slaves, recognizing that you also have a Master in heaven.

verses.heading: Further Injunctions / Further Injunctions
verses.text: Devote yourselves persistently to prayer, remaining alert in it with thanksgiving.
Pray simultaneously for us as well, that God would open a door for us to proclaim the message, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I have been imprisoned—
so that I may declare it with clarity, as I am obligated to speak.
Conduct yourselves with wisdom toward those outside the faith, making the most of every opportunity.
Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so you will know how to respond appropriately to each person.

verses.heading: Paul’s Fellow Workers in the Lord / Paul’s Fellow Workers in the Lord
verses.text: Tychicus, my dear brother and faithful servant and fellow worker in the Lord, will inform you about everything concerning my circumstances.
I have sent him to you for this precise purpose: so that you may learn about our situation and so that he may encourage your hearts.
He is coming with Onesimus, my faithful and dear brother, who is one of your own. They will tell you about everything happening here.
Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, sends you greetings, as does Mark, Barnabas’ cousin (you have received instructions about him; if he comes to you, welcome him),
and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s kingdom who are from the circumcised community—they have been a source of comfort to me.

Epaphras, who is one of your own, sends greetings. As a servant of Christ Jesus, he is always wrestling in prayer on your behalf, so that you may stand mature and completely assured in everything God wills.
For I testify about him that he works hard for you and for those in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
Luke, the beloved physician, sends greetings, as does Demas.
Give my greetings to the brothers and sisters in Laodicea, and to Nympha and the church that meets in her house.
After this letter has been read to your congregation, make sure it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans, and that you in turn read the letter from Laodicea.
Tell Archippus: “Pay attention to the ministry you received in the Lord, so that you fulfill it completely.”

verses.heading: Final Greeting and Benediction / Final Greeting and Benediction
verses.text: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my imprisonment. Grace be with you.

verses.heading: Apostolic Greeting / Apostolic Greeting
verses.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of believers in Thessalonica who are united in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: May you experience grace or unmerited favor and peace.

verses.heading: Thanksgiving to God for the Thessalonians’ Exemplary Faith and Life / Thanksgiving to God for the Thessalonians’ Exemplary Faith and Life
verses.text: We give thanks to God constantly for every one of you, making mention of you in our prayers without ceasing,

continually bringing to remembrance before our God and Father the active deeds produced by your faith, the strenuous efforts motivated by your love, and the steadfast endurance inspired by your confident expectation in our Lord Jesus Christ.
We are certain, brothers and sisters who are dearly loved by God, that He has chosen you for salvation,

for the good news we proclaimed did not reach you through mere verbal communication alone, but came with divine enabling, with the presence and activity of the Holy Spirit, and with complete assurance of its truth—just as you witnessed the manner of life we lived among you for your spiritual benefit.
And you followed our example and the Lord's pattern when you welcomed the word amid intense suffering, yet with gladness that came from the Holy Spirit,
so that you became an example worth following for all who trust in Christ throughout the regions of Macedonia and Achaia.

For the message about the Lord has sounded forth from you not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but the news of your trust in God has spread to every place, so that we have no need to speak about it ourselves.

For the people in those regions continue to tell the story of what kind of welcome you gave us, and how you abandoned your idols and turned to the one true God, to serve the God who is alive and real,
and to await with eager anticipation the return of His Son from the heavenly realm, the One whom He raised from death—Jesus, who rescues us from the divine judgment that is coming.

verses.heading: Paul’s Ministry to the Thessalonians / Paul’s Ministry to the Thessalonians
verses.text: For you yourselves recognize, brothers and sisters, that our coming to you did not fail to achieve its purpose.

But rather, even though we had already endured suffering and shameful treatment at Philippi, as you are fully aware, we gained boldness in our God to declare the good news of God to you amid great conflict and struggle.
For the message we bring does not originate from error or from corrupt intentions, nor do we employ cunning manipulation.

But just as we have been tested and found trustworthy by God to be given responsibility for the gospel message, in that same manner we speak—not seeking to gain human approval, but to satisfy God, who tests and evaluates our inner motivations.
For we never resorted to words of flattery, as you can testify, nor did we act with hidden motives of greed—God stands as witness to this truth.
We were not looking for honor from human beings—neither from you nor from others—though as apostles of Christ we had the right to make demands and assert our position.
But instead, we conducted ourselves with gentleness in your midst, like a mother who nurses and tenderly cares for her own children.
Because we cared for you so deeply, we were eager to impart to you not only God’s good news but also our own lives, since you had become extremely precious to us.

For you remember, brothers and sisters, the exhausting labor and hard work we endured: laboring day and night so as not to place a financial burden on anyone among you, we proclaimed to you the good news of God.
You yourselves are witnesses, and God also, how reverently, justly, and irreproachably we behaved toward you who believe.
Just as you know that we dealt with each individual among you in the way a father deals with his own children—
urging you forward, comforting you, and charging you solemnly to walk in a manner that befits God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.

And for this reason we also thank God without ceasing, that when you received God’s word which you heard from us, you welcomed it not as merely human teaching but as what it actually is—the word of God, which is performing its work powerfully in you who trust in Him.

For you, brothers and sisters, became followers of the churches of God in Christ Jesus located in Judea, for you experienced the same kinds of sufferings from your own countrymen that they experienced from the Jewish authorities,
who put to death both the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and who persecuted us severely. They are displeasing to God and stand in opposition to all humanity

by attempting to prevent us from speaking to the Gentile nations so that they might be saved. Thus they continually fill up the full measure of their sins. Yet the wrath of God has come upon them at last.

verses.heading: Paul’s Intense Desire to Visit the Thessalonians / Paul’s Intense Desire to Visit the Thessalonians
verses.text: But as for us, brothers and sisters, having been separated from you for a short period—absent in body but never in heart—we made extraordinary efforts, driven by intense longing, to see your faces once more.
For this reason we determined to come to you—I, Paul, made the attempt more than once—but Satan hindered us and prevented our coming.
For who represents our confident expectation or our delight or our boast of achievement in the presence of our Lord Jesus when He appears? Is it not you yourselves?
Yes indeed, you are our glory and our joy.
So when we could bear the separation no longer, we thought it best to remain behind in Athens alone,
and we sent Timothy, our brother and co-worker with God in proclaiming the gospel of Christ, to establish you firmly and to exhort you concerning your faith,
so that no one would be disturbed or unsettled by these afflictions. For you yourselves understand that we are appointed to face such trials.
For indeed, when we were present with you, we told you in advance that we were going to experience tribulation, and so it came to pass, as you well know.

For this very reason, when I could endure the uncertainty no longer, I sent to learn about the state of your faith, fearing that perhaps the one who tempts had tempted you and that our hard work might have become worthless.

verses.heading: Timothy’s Report of the Thessalonians’ Faith and Love / Timothy’s Report of the Thessalonians’ Faith and Love
verses.text: But now Timothy has just returned to us from you and has brought us encouraging news about your faith and love, and that you maintain good memories of us at all times, desiring earnestly to see us just as we also long to see you—
for this reason, brothers and sisters, amid all our trouble and affliction we have been greatly comforted regarding you, through the report of your faith.
For now we are truly living, if you remain standing firm in the Lord.
For what sufficient thanks can we possibly return to God concerning you, in view of all the exceeding joy with which we rejoice on your account in the presence of our God,
while we petition Him most fervently night and day that we might see you face to face and complete whatever may still be lacking in your faith?

verses.heading: Pauline Prayer / Pauline Prayer
verses.text: Now may our God and Father Himself, together with our Lord Jesus, direct our path to you.
And may the Lord cause you to grow and overflow in love toward one another and toward all people, even as we abound in love toward you,
so that He may strengthen your hearts to be unblemished in holiness before our God and Father when our Lord Jesus comes with all who belong to Him.

verses.heading: Excelling in Living and Pleasing God / Excelling in Living and Pleasing God
verses.text: Finally, brothers and sisters, we request and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that just as you received instruction from us concerning how you ought to conduct your lives and please God—as indeed you are doing—you should progress in this even more abundantly.
For you understand what directives we communicated to you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
For what God desires is your sanctification: that you keep yourselves away from sexual immorality,
that each of you understand how to possess his own vessel in sanctification and honor,
not in the passion of lustful desire like the Gentile nations who have no knowledge of God,
that no one overstep boundaries and take advantage of his brother in any matter, because the Lord executes vengeance concerning all these things, just as we told you before and testified solemnly.
For God has not called us to a life characterized by moral uncleanness but to a life set apart in holiness.
Consequently, the one who disregards this directive is not rejecting human authority but is rejecting God, who also supplies His Holy Spirit to you.

verses.heading: Brotherly Love / Brotherly Love
verses.text: Now concerning love for fellow believers, you have no requirement for me to write to you, for you yourselves have been instructed by God to love one another.
And in fact you are practicing this toward all the brothers and sisters throughout the whole region of Macedonia. But we encourage you, brothers and sisters, to increase in this more and more,
and to consider it a point of honor to lead a tranquil life, to attend to your own responsibilities, and to labor with your own hands, exactly as we commanded you,
so that you may conduct yourselves with dignity toward those who are outside the faith and not be financially dependent on anyone.

verses.heading: The Coming of the Lord / The Coming of the Lord
verses.text: But we do not want you to remain ignorant, brothers and sisters, concerning those who have died, so that you will not sorrow as do the rest of humanity who possess no hope.
For if we are convinced that Jesus died and rose to life again, even so God will bring with Jesus those who have died in union with Him.
For this we declare to you based on a word from the Lord Himself: that we who are living and surviving until the coming of the Lord will by no means go ahead of those who have already died.
Because the Lord Himself will come down from heaven with a commanding shout, with the voice of a leading angel, and with God’s trumpet blast, and the dead who are in Christ will rise first of all.
After that, we who are still living and remaining will be caught up together with them in the clouds for a meeting with the Lord in the air, and in this way we will be with the Lord forever.
So then, give encouragement to one another through these truths.

verses.heading: The Eschatological Day of the Lord / The Eschatological Day of the Lord
verses.text: Now regarding the periods and appointed times, brothers and sisters, you do not need to have anything written to you.
For you yourselves understand perfectly well that the day of the Lord arrives in the same manner as a thief comes in the night.

Whenever people are declaring, “All is peaceful and safe,” then unexpected destruction comes upon them suddenly, just as birth pains come upon a woman who is pregnant, and they will by no means escape.
But you, brothers and sisters, are not living in darkness, so that the day should overtake you as a thief would.
For all of you are sons belonging to light and sons belonging to day. We have no association with night or with darkness.
Therefore, let us not be sleeping as the rest of humanity does, but let us remain watchful and maintain self-control.
For those who are sleeping sleep at night, and those who become intoxicated get drunk at night.

But since we are of the day, let us be self-controlled, clothing ourselves with faith and love as protective armor for the chest, and with the confident expectation of salvation as a helmet for the head.
Because God has not appointed us to experience His wrath but to gain salvation by means of our Lord Jesus Christ,
who died on our behalf so that whether we are awake in life or asleep in death, we should live in union with Him.
For this reason, keep encouraging one another and keep building one another up spiritually, exactly as you are indeed doing.

verses.heading: Various Exhortations / Various Exhortations
verses.text: Now we request of you, brothers and sisters, to recognize and appreciate those who labor diligently among you, who exercise leadership over you in the Lord’s service and who give you admonition,
and to regard them with extraordinary love because of the work they perform. Maintain peaceful relationships with one another.

We urge you strongly, brothers and sisters: Admonish those who live in an undisciplined manner, speak encouragingly to those who are anxious or discouraged, support those who are weak, exercise patience toward all people.
Take care that no one returns evil in payment for evil to anyone, but always pursue what is beneficial both for one another and for all people.
Rejoice continuously,
pray without ceasing,
give thanks in every situation, for this is what God desires from you in Christ Jesus.
Do not suppress or extinguish the work of the Spirit.
Do not regard prophetic utterances as worthless,
but examine all things carefully; retain what is good and valuable.
Keep away from every kind of evil.

verses.heading: Pauline Prayer and Request for Prayer / Pauline Prayer and Request for Prayer
verses.text: Now may the God who gives peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may the whole of your being—spirit, soul, and body—be preserved complete and without blame at the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ.
The One who calls you is completely trustworthy, and He will certainly bring this to fulfillment.
Brothers and sisters, continue to pray on our behalf.

verses.heading: Greeting, Admonition and Benediction / Greeting, Admonition and Benediction
verses.text: Give greetings to all the brothers and sisters with a holy kiss of fellowship.
I place you under solemn obligation by the Lord to have this letter read aloud to all the brothers and sisters.
May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

verses.heading: Apostolic Greeting / Apostolic Greeting
verses.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians who live in God our Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ.
May grace or unmerited favor and peace be given to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.heading: Giving Thanks to God on Behalf of the Saints / Giving Thanks to God on Behalf of the Saints
verses.text: We are continually obligated to thank God for you, brothers and sisters, as is entirely appropriate, because your faith is advancing remarkably and the love each one of you has for one another is steadily increasing.

As a result, we ourselves speak with pride about you among the churches of God, because of your steadfast endurance and faith in the midst of all the persecutions and hardships that you are continuing to bear.

verses.heading: Eschatological Judgment and Glory / Eschatological Judgment and Glory
verses.text: All of this serves as clear evidence of the righteous judgment of God, demonstrating that you will be regarded as worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are now suffering.
For it is right and just for God to repay distress to those who are causing you distress,
and to grant relief to you who are being afflicted, along with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His powerful angels,
appearing in blazing fire to execute righteous judgment on those who do not know God and on those who refuse to obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
Such people will suffer the penalty of everlasting ruin, separated from the presence of the Lord and from the manifestation of His majestic power,
when He comes on that day to be glorified among His saints and to be marveled at among all who have believed, because the testimony we delivered to you was accepted as true.

verses.heading: Pauline Prayer / Pauline Prayer
verses.text: With this goal in view, we always pray for you, that our God may regard you as worthy of His calling and may bring to full completion every resolve for goodness and every work produced by faith through His power,
so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be honored in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.heading: The Revelation of the Man of Lawlessness / The Revelation of the Man of Lawlessness
verses.text: Now we appeal to you, brothers and sisters, regarding the return of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered to Him,

that you not be easily unsettled in your thinking or thrown into fear, whether by a spiritual claim, by a spoken message, or by a letter alleged to come from us, asserting that the day of the Lord has already arrived.
Do not allow anyone to mislead you in any manner, because that day will not occur unless the rebellion comes first and the man of lawlessness is unveiled, the one destined for destruction,
who sets himself in opposition and elevates himself above every so-called god or object of worship, to the point that he installs himself in the sanctuary of God, publicly presenting himself as God.
Do you not remember that I repeatedly spoke about these matters while I was still with you?
And now you know what is presently restraining him, so that he will be revealed at the appointed time.
For the hidden force of lawlessness is already at work; only the One who restrains it now will continue to do so until He is removed from the way.
Then the lawless one will be openly revealed, whom the Lord will destroy by the breath of His mouth and render powerless by the splendor of His appearing.
The coming of this one is in accordance with the activity of Satan, accompanied by every kind of counterfeit power, signs, and deceptive wonders,
and by every form of wicked deception directed toward those who are perishing, because they refused to welcome the love of the truth that would have brought them salvation.
For this reason, God sends upon them a powerful delusion, so that they will embrace what is false,
in order that all may be judged who did not believe the truth, but took pleasure in unrighteousness.

verses.heading: Giving Thanks to God / Giving Thanks to God
verses.text: But we must always thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because from the beginning God chose you for salvation through sanctification by the Spirit and faith in the truth.
It was for this very purpose that He called you through our gospel, so that you might share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.heading: Encouragement to Stand Resolute / Encouragement to Stand Resolute
verses.text: Therefore, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold tightly to the teachings you were instructed in, whether conveyed by spoken message or by a letter from us.

verses.heading: Pauline Prayer / Pauline Prayer
verses.text: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself, and God our Father, who loved us and graciously granted us eternal encouragement and a good hope,
strengthen your hearts and establish you in every good deed and word.

verses.heading: Paul’s Appeal for Prayer / Paul’s Appeal for Prayer
verses.text: Finally, brothers and sisters, pray for us, so that the message of the Lord may spread rapidly and be honored, just as it was among you,
and that we may be rescued from corrupt and wicked people, for faith is not possessed by everyone.
But the Lord is faithful; He will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.
We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you are practicing and will continue to practice the things we instruct you to do.

verses.heading: Pauline Prayer / Pauline Prayer
verses.text: May the Lord guide your hearts into the love of God and into steadfast endurance shaped by Christ.

verses.heading: Warning Against Idleness / Warning Against Idleness
verses.text: Now we command you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to withdraw from every brother who lives in a disorderly manner and not in accordance with the teaching they received from us.
For you yourselves know how you ought to follow our example, because we did not live irresponsibly while we were among you,
nor did we accept food from anyone without payment, but with exhausting labor we worked day and night, so that we would not place a burden on any of you.
This was not because we lacked the right to such support, but in order to present ourselves as a pattern for you to imitate.
Even while we were with you, we repeatedly gave this instruction: If anyone is unwilling to work, that person should not eat.
For we hear that some among you are living irresponsibly, not working at all, but interfering in matters that do not concern them.
Such people we command and urge in the Lord Jesus Christ to work quietly and earn the food they themselves eat.
But you, brothers and sisters, do not lose heart in doing what is good.
If anyone does not obey our instruction in this letter, take note of that person and do not associate closely with him, so that he may feel the seriousness of his conduct.
Yet do not treat him as an enemy, but warn him as a brother.

verses.heading: Pauline Prayer / Pauline Prayer
verses.text: Now may the Lord of peace Himself grant you peace at all times and in every circumstance. The Lord be with you all.

verses.heading: Greeting / Greeting
verses.text: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which serves as a mark of authenticity in every letter. This is how I write.
May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.

verses.heading: Apostolic Greeting / Apostolic Greeting
verses.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the direct and authoritative decree of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus who is our confident expectation,
To Timothy, my genuine spiritual son in the faith: May you experience grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.heading: Furthering God’s Plan / Furthering God’s Plan
verses.text: I am restating the directive I issued to you as I was setting out for Macedonia: Stay in Ephesus in order to charge certain individuals to cease propagating teachings that deviate from the truth,

and to stop occupying themselves with fabricated myths and endless ancestral records, which stimulate pointless controversies rather than promoting God’s work of salvation that is accomplished through faith.
Now the goal and purpose of this command is love that springs from a heart that is pure, from a conscience that is clear and unburdened, and from faith that is authentic and without pretense.
Certain individuals have missed this target entirely and have turned away to engage in pointless conversation,
wanting to be recognized as authorities on the Law, though they grasp neither the meaning of what they are asserting nor the topics on which they speak with such dogmatic certainty.
But we recognize that the Law serves a good purpose if one uses it in the way it was intended to be used,

understanding this fundamental principle: that law exists not to govern a person who is already righteous but to restrain those who break laws and refuse authority, those who have no reverence for God and who live in sin, those who treat nothing as sacred and who commit profane acts, those who strike down their fathers or mothers, those who commit murder,

those who engage in sexual immorality, men who engage in homosexual practice, those who kidnap and sell human beings, those who speak lies, those who commit perjury under oath, and anything else that stands contrary to teaching that promotes spiritual health,
in keeping with the gospel that reveals God’s glory—the gospel of the God who is blessed, which was committed to my trust.

verses.heading: Paul is Grateful to God for His Grace / Paul is Grateful to God for His Grace
verses.text: I express deep thankfulness to Christ Jesus our Lord, who has supplied me with strength, for He considered me faithful when He placed me into ministry,

despite the fact that previously I was one who spoke blasphemy against Him, one who hunted down His followers, and one who acted with insolent violence. Nevertheless, I was shown mercy because I acted out of ignorance, not yet having believed,
and the grace of our Lord overflowed toward me in superabundant measure, bringing with it the faith and love that exist in union with Christ Jesus.
This is a statement you can completely rely upon and that merits wholehearted acceptance: Christ Jesus entered into the world with the purpose of rescuing sinners—and among sinners I am foremost.

But it was for this precise reason that I was granted mercy, so that in me as the foremost of sinners, Christ Jesus might demonstrate the full extent of His patience, making me an illustrative example for those who would place their trust in Him for eternal life.

verses.heading: Doxology / Doxology
verses.text: Now to the King of all ages, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

verses.heading: Instruction Given to Timothy / Instruction Given to Timothy
verses.text: I am placing this responsibility upon you, Timothy my son, in harmony with the prophetic words that were spoken over you in the past, so that strengthened by those prophecies you may fight the noble spiritual battle,
holding firmly to faith and a good conscience. Some have thrust these away from themselves and as a result have suffered complete ruin concerning their faith.
In this category are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan so that through painful discipline they will be taught not to speak blasphemy.

verses.heading: Praying for All People / Praying for All People
verses.text: I strongly urge, then, as the first priority, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgiving be made for all human beings,
for kings and for all who occupy positions of governmental authority, in order that we might live a peaceful and quiet life marked by full godliness and dignity in every respect.
This practice is good and finds acceptance in the presence of God our Savior,
who wants all human beings to be saved and come to possess full and accurate knowledge of the truth.
For one God exists, and one mediator stands between God and humanity, the man Christ Jesus,
who surrendered Himself as the price of redemption for all people—this declaration was made at the time appointed by God—

and it is for the proclamation of this truth that I was appointed as a herald and as an apostle (I am telling the truth and not lying), as an instructor of the Gentile nations in the realm of faith and truth.

verses.heading: Instructions for Christian Men and Women / Instructions for Christian Men and Women
verses.text: My desire, then, is that in every place of gathering the men should offer prayers, raising up hands that are set apart and holy, free from anger and from contentious argument.

In the same way, I desire that women should present themselves in clothing that is fitting and proper, adorning themselves with modesty and sensible restraint, not with intricately braided hairstyles or with gold jewelry or with pearls or with expensive clothing,
but instead with what is appropriate for women who profess to revere God—that is, through deeds that demonstrate goodness and virtue.
A woman should receive instruction in a quiet and peaceful manner with an attitude of full submission to the teaching.
I do not allow a woman to teach or to assume authority over a man; rather, she is to remain quiet.
For Adam was fashioned and formed first, and only afterward was Eve created.
And it was not Adam who was deceived and led into transgression; rather, it was the woman who was completely deceived and fell into violation of God’s command.

verses.heading: Notes / Notes
verses.text: Yet she will be preserved through the bearing of children, if they continue in faith and love and holiness, accompanied by self-control.* 15 The shift from the singular pronoun she to the plural pronoun they reflects normal usage in Koine Greek, where she refers specifically to Eve and they extends the application to women as a category.
verses.html:
Yet she will be preserved through the bearing of children, if they continue in faith and love and holiness, accompanied by self-control.*
15 The shift from the singular pronoun she to the plural pronoun they reflects normal usage in Koine Greek, where she refers specifically to Eve and they extends the application to women as a category.

verses.heading: Qualifications for Overseers / Qualifications for Overseers
verses.text: This is a trustworthy saying: If anyone aspires to the position of overseer, he is aspiring to something that is noble and excellent.
An overseer, therefore, must be beyond reproach, faithful to his one wife, temperate, prudent, orderly, given to hospitality, skilled in teaching,
not addicted to wine, not prone to violence but gentle, not contentious, not greedy for money.
He must manage his own household competently, keeping his children under control with complete respectability.
(For if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how will he care for God’s church?)
He must not be someone who has only recently come to faith, so that he will not become puffed up with pride and fall under the same condemnation that befell the devil.
Moreover, he must possess a good reputation among those outside the church, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the devil’s snare.

verses.heading: Qualifications for Deacons / Qualifications for Deacons
verses.text: Deacons, in the same manner, must be worthy of respect, not speaking with duplicity, not given to excessive wine consumption, not pursuing dishonest financial gain,
holding firmly to the profound truth of the faith with a clear conscience.
These men must also first be examined; then let them serve as deacons if they prove themselves blameless.
Women similarly must be worthy of respect, not given to malicious gossip, temperate, trustworthy in every matter.
Deacons must be faithful to their one wife, managing their children and their own households well.
For those who have served well as deacons gain an excellent standing for themselves and great boldness in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.

verses.heading: The Mystery of Godliness / The Mystery of Godliness
verses.text: I am writing these instructions to you, though I hope to come to you soon.
But if my arrival is delayed, I am writing so you will know how people ought to conduct themselves in God’s household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and support of the truth.

And without dispute, great is the revealed mystery that produces godly living: He appeared in human form, was vindicated by the Spirit, was seen by heavenly beings, was proclaimed among the nations, was believed on by people throughout the world, and was received into glory.

verses.heading: In Later Times / In Later Times
verses.text: Now the Spirit states explicitly and unmistakably that in later periods of time some will depart from the faith, giving their attention and allegiance to spirits that deceive and to doctrines that have their origin in demonic powers,
transmitted through the pretense and hypocrisy of those who speak lies, whose own consciences have been seared and rendered insensitive as if by a hot iron,
who prohibit marriage and command abstinence from foods that God brought into existence to be consumed with gratitude by those who trust Him and who have come to recognize the truth.
For every created thing that comes from God is good and beneficial, and nothing should be cast aside as unacceptable if it is received with an attitude of thanksgiving,
for it is made holy and sanctified through the word of God and through prayer.

verses.heading: A Good Servant of Christ Jesus / A Good Servant of Christ Jesus
verses.text: If you place these teachings before the brothers and sisters, you will prove yourself to be an excellent servant of Christ Jesus, one who is constantly fed and strengthened by the truths of the faith and by the good teaching that you have closely followed.
But have nothing to do with godless tales told by old women and with foolish speculations, and instead train yourself rigorously for godliness.
For bodily exercise provides benefit that is limited in scope, but godliness is valuable in all respects, holding promise for both the life we live now and for the life that is yet to come.
This saying is reliable and worthy of being fully embraced and accepted.

For it is precisely for this purpose that we exert ourselves and struggle intensely, because we have placed our confident hope in the living God, who is the Savior of all human beings, and especially of those who believe.
Issue these directives as commands and communicate them as instructions.

Let no one treat you with dismissive contempt on account of your youth, but instead become a model and example for those who believe, in your speech, in your way of life, in your love, in your faith, and in your purity.
Until the time when I arrive, apply yourself diligently to the public reading of Scripture, to the work of exhorting and encouraging, and to the task of teaching.
Do not disregard or fail to use the spiritual gift that resides within you, which was imparted to you through prophetic declaration when the body of elders laid their hands upon you.
Practice these disciplines with diligence and immerse yourself completely in them, so that your spiritual advancement and growth will be plainly visible to everyone.

Pay careful attention both to your personal life and to the content of your teaching. Continue steadfastly in these pursuits, for by doing this you will ensure salvation both for yourself and for those who hear you.

verses.heading: Instructions for the Believers / Instructions for the Believers
verses.text: Never rebuke an older man with harsh severity, but rather appeal to him with the respect you would show to a father; treat younger men as you would brothers,
older women as you would mothers, and younger women as you would sisters, maintaining purity in all your interactions.

verses.heading: Honoring the True Widows / Honoring the True Widows
verses.text: Give recognition and provide support for widows who are truly without family support.

But if any widow has children or grandchildren, these family members must first learn to demonstrate godly devotion within their own household and to make return to their parents for what they have received, for this is acceptable in God’s sight.
The woman who is genuinely left alone as a widow has set her hope and expectation on God and perseveres in making earnest requests and prayers during both nighttime and daytime hours.
But the widow who devotes herself to pleasure-seeking and self-gratification is dead in a spiritual sense even though she continues to live physically.
Command and teach these principles so that the believers may be beyond reproach.

But if anyone refuses to provide for his own relatives, and most especially for the members of his immediate household, he has repudiated the faith and proved himself worse in behavior than someone who has never believed.
Let a widow be enrolled on the list for support only if she has reached at least sixty years of age and has remained faithful to one husband throughout her life,

and if she has gained recognition for performing good deeds, such as raising children with care, extending hospitality to strangers, washing the feet of God's people in humble service, bringing relief to those experiencing affliction, and pursuing with dedication every form of good work.
But refuse to place younger widows on the official list, because when their physical desires draw them away from single-minded devotion to Christ, they wish to enter into marriage,
and thus incur judgment and condemnation because they have set aside and broken their previous commitment.

Moreover, at the same time they form the habit of being idle and unproductive, going from one house to another, and they become not only idle but also gossips and busybodies, talking about subjects that are none of their concern.

I desire, therefore, that younger widows should marry, bear children, exercise responsible management of their homes, and provide no opportunity or grounds for the enemy to bring accusations and slander.
For already some have abandoned the right path and turned aside to follow after Satan.

If any woman who is a believer has widows who are related to her or dependent on her, let her provide assistance to them, so that the burden does not fall on the church and the church can give aid to those who are widows in the truest sense.

verses.heading: Honoring the Preaching and Teaching Elders / Honoring the Preaching and Teaching Elders
verses.text: Let the elders who exercise leadership in an excellent manner be considered deserving of double honor, and especially those who work hard in the tasks of preaching and teaching.
For the Scripture affirms, “Do not prevent an ox from eating while it treads out the grain,”* and also states, “The laborer deserves to receive his wages.”*
Do not accept or entertain an accusation brought against an elder unless the charge is confirmed by the testimony of two or three witnesses.
Those who continue in sinful practices should be reproved in the presence of the entire congregation, so that the rest will experience wholesome fear and take warning.

verses.heading: Other Instructions / Other Instructions
verses.text: I give you this charge with utmost seriousness in the presence of God, in the presence of Christ Jesus, and in the presence of the angels who have been chosen, that you maintain these directives without allowing prejudice or partiality, doing nothing that shows favoritism to one person over another.
Do not act hastily in laying hands on anyone to commission them for service, and do not become a participant in the sins that others commit. Guard your own purity carefully.
Do not continue to drink only water, but take a small amount of wine for the sake of your stomach and your frequent ailments.

verses.heading: The Obviousness of Sins and Good Works / The Obviousness of Sins and Good Works
verses.text: The sins of certain people are obvious and evident, proceeding ahead of them to judgment, while the sins of others trail behind and are revealed only later.

verses.heading: Notes / Notes
verses.text: In the same way, good works are clearly visible, and even those that are less obvious cannot remain hidden. 18 Quoted from Deut. 25:4 18 Quoted from Matt. 10:10; Lk. 10:7

verses.heading: Honoring Masters / Honoring Masters
verses.text: All those who find themselves in the position of slaves under the authority of masters should consider their own masters worthy of complete respect and honor, so that the reputation of God’s name and the content of Christian teaching will not be subjected to slander and insult.

And those slaves who serve masters who are fellow believers must not show them less respect simply because they share a spiritual brotherhood, but rather should serve them with even greater dedication and excellence, precisely because those who receive the benefit of their faithful service are believers and are loved by God. Continue to teach and urge these principles.

verses.heading: False Teachers and Greed / False Teachers and Greed
verses.text: If anyone is propagating teaching that differs from the truth and does not give consent to the sound and healthy words of our Lord Jesus Christ and to teaching that accords with godliness,

that person is filled with arrogant pride and possesses no genuine understanding. Instead, he has a diseased craving for controversies and battles over the meaning of words, from which arise envy, quarrels, slanderous speech, and evil suspicions,
and constant friction and conflict among individuals whose minds have been corrupted and who have been robbed of the truth, people who suppose that godliness is a means of acquiring financial gain.
But godliness when combined with contentment is in fact a source of great gain and enrichment.
For we carried nothing into this world when we were born, and it is certain that we cannot carry anything out of it when we die.
But if we possess food to eat and clothing to wear, we shall be content with these provisions.

But those who have set their hearts on becoming wealthy fall into temptation and into a snare and into many senseless and destructive cravings that drag people down into ruin and ultimate destruction.

For the love of money serves as a root from which all kinds of evils spring forth, and in their intense desire for it some have been led astray from the faith and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows and agonies.

verses.heading: Instructions for Timothy / Instructions for Timothy
verses.text: But you, as a man who belongs to God and serves Him, must run away from these things and instead pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, steadfast endurance, and gentleness of spirit.
Fight the good fight that belongs to the life of faith; lay hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made your excellent confession of faith in the presence of many witnesses.
I command you solemnly in the sight of God, who gives life to all creatures, and in the sight of Christ Jesus, who made His good confession when He testified before Pontius Pilate,
that you observe and keep this command in a way that is spotless and beyond reproach until the visible appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
which God will bring about at the time He has determined, He who is the blessed and only Sovereign, the King of kings and Lord of lords,

who alone possesses immortality by His very nature and who inhabits light so intense that no one can approach it, whom no human being has ever seen with physical eyes nor has the ability to see. To Him belong honor and power that endures forever. Amen.

Give this command to those who possess wealth in this present age: that they should not be haughty or lift themselves up in pride, and that they should not set their hope on riches, which are uncertain and unstable, but rather on God, who generously provides us with all things in abundance for us to enjoy.
Command them to practice doing good, to accumulate wealth in the form of good works, to be generous in giving, and to be willing to share what they have with others,
in this way laying up for themselves treasure that will serve as a firm foundation for the age to come, so that they may grasp hold of the life that is truly and genuinely life.
O Timothy, guard carefully what has been entrusted to your keeping. Turn away from the profane and empty chatter and from the contradictory claims of what is falsely labeled as “knowledge,”
which certain people have laid claim to and in doing so have missed the mark and strayed from the faith. May grace be with all of you.

verses.heading: Greeting / Greeting
verses.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by God’s sovereign choice and appointment, commissioned in accordance with the promise of eternal life that is available in Christ Jesus,
To Timothy, my beloved spiritual son: May you experience grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.heading: Stir into Flame the Gift of God in You / Stir into Flame the Gift of God in You
verses.text: I express gratitude to God, whom I worship with a conscience free from guilt just as my forefathers did, as I make mention of you constantly in my prayers both during the night hours and throughout the day.
I am filled with longing to see you again, remembering the tears you shed at our parting, so that I might be filled with complete joy.

I hold in my memory the sincere and authentic faith that resides in you, the same faith that first made its home in your grandmother Lois and in your mother Eunice, and I remain fully convinced that this faith now lives powerfully in you as well.
It is for this very reason that I remind you to fan into flame and keep ablaze the spiritual gift that God placed within you when I laid my hands upon you in commissioning.
For the Spirit that God has imparted to us does not produce cowardice or timidity, but rather produces power, love, and disciplined thinking.

verses.heading: Instructions for Timothy / Instructions for Timothy
verses.text: So do not be embarrassed about bearing witness to our Lord, nor be ashamed of me who am imprisoned because of Him, but join with me in accepting hardship for the sake of the gospel, drawing strength from the power that God supplies,

who has rescued us from condemnation and summoned us with a calling that is holy and set apart, not because of anything we have accomplished, but in accordance with His own predetermined plan and the grace He freely gave us in Christ Jesus from before the ages of time began,

and this grace has now been openly revealed through the arrival of our Savior Christ Jesus, who has abolished the power and authority of death and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.
It is for the sake of this gospel that I was designated as a public proclaimer, as an apostle with authority, and as an instructor of truth.

It is because of my commitment to this gospel that I am experiencing these present hardships, yet I feel no shame, for I have intimate knowledge of the One in whom I have invested my confidence, and I stand fully persuaded that He possesses the ability to safeguard what I have placed in His care until the day of His return.
Maintain as your standard the collection of healthy teachings that you received from me, holding them in the context of the faith and love that are experienced in Christ Jesus.
Protect the precious deposit of truth that has been entrusted to your care, doing so by the power of the Holy Spirit who makes His dwelling within us.

verses.heading: The Household of Onesiphorus and Paul / The Household of Onesiphorus and Paul
verses.text: You are aware of this reality, that all the believers in the province of Asia have abandoned me, and among these are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
May the Lord extend compassion to the family of Onesiphorus, for he repeatedly brought refreshment to my spirit and felt no embarrassment about the chains I wear as a prisoner.
On the contrary, when he came to the city of Rome, he pursued me with great determination until he located me.
May the Lord allow him to experience divine mercy from the Lord on the day of final judgment. And you are thoroughly aware of the many ways he ministered to me during my time in Ephesus.

verses.heading: Be Strong in God’s Grace / Be Strong in God’s Grace
verses.text: As for you, my spiritual son, you must continually draw your inner strength from the grace that flows from union with Christ Jesus.
The truths that you received from me in the hearing of numerous witnesses, these you must pass on and entrust to reliable individuals who will possess the capacity to teach still others.
Accept your portion of suffering alongside me, conducting yourself as a well-trained soldier who belongs to Christ Jesus.

No soldier engaged in military service entangles himself in the everyday affairs and business pursuits of civilian life, for his objective is to satisfy and please the commanding officer who recruited him.
In the same way, a competitor in athletic contests does not receive the winner’s crown unless he adheres strictly to the regulations governing the competition.
The farmer who labors with dedication deserves to be the first to partake of the crops he has cultivated.
Consider thoughtfully what I am communicating to you, for the Lord will provide you with insight and comprehension in all these things.
Keep your mind continually focused on Jesus Christ, who was raised from death to life, who came from the lineage of David, exactly as my gospel message declares.

It is on account of this gospel that I am experiencing affliction, to the extent of being confined with chains as though I were a dangerous criminal; yet the message of God is not subject to imprisonment or restraint.

Therefore I willingly bear all things for the benefit of those whom God has chosen, so that they as well might attain the deliverance that comes through Christ Jesus, accompanied by glory that lasts forever.
This statement deserves complete trust and confidence: For if we have experienced death in union with Him, we shall also experience life in union with Him;
if we persevere through trials with endurance, we shall also exercise royal authority alongside Him; if we repudiate Him, He likewise will repudiate us;
if we demonstrate unfaithfulness, He continues to demonstrate faithfulness, for it is impossible for Him to act contrary to His own character.

verses.heading: Present Yourself Approved to God / Present Yourself Approved to God
verses.text: Continue to bring these truths to the remembrance of the brothers and sisters, giving them solemn warning in God’s presence not to quarrel about words, a practice that accomplishes no beneficial purpose and leads to the spiritual destruction of those who hear such arguments.

Give diligent effort to offer yourself to God as one who has passed the test and received approval, as a laborer who has no cause for shame, who correctly interprets and accurately communicates the message of truth.
But keep yourself distant from godless and meaningless chatter, for those who engage in it will advance further and further into ungodly living,
and their false teaching will consume and spread like a gangrenous infection. Among these false teachers are Hymenaeus and Philetus.

These men have deviated from the truth by asserting that the resurrection of believers has already taken place in the past, and by this claim they are undermining and destroying the faith of certain individuals.

Yet despite this, the solid foundation that God has laid remains unshaken and stable, marked with this inscription: “The Lord recognizes and knows intimately those who truly belong to Him,” and, “Let everyone who calls upon the Lord’s name separate himself from wickedness and injustice.”

Now in a large and wealthy house there exist not only containers fashioned from gold and silver, but also containers made from wood and earthenware, and some are designated for noble purposes while others serve common or degrading functions.

So if anyone purifies himself by removing himself from what is ignoble and dishonorable, he will become a vessel designated for honorable use, consecrated and set apart, valuable and useful to the Master of the house, and fully prepared and equipped for every kind of good work.

Run away from the desires and impulses characteristic of youth, and instead pursue after righteousness, faithful trust, self-giving love, and harmony with others, doing so in company with those who invoke the Lord’s name from hearts that are pure and sincere.
Turn away from and refuse to engage in foolish speculations and ignorant debates, because you understand that these generate conflicts and quarrels.

And a servant who belongs to the Lord must not be characterized by a contentious spirit, but instead must demonstrate kindness toward all people, must possess the ability to communicate truth effectively, must show patience when he is mistreated or insulted,
instructing those who stand in opposition with a spirit of gentleness and humility, hoping that perhaps God will grant them a change of mind that leads to full recognition of the truth,
and that they will return to their right senses and break free from the trap the devil has set, having been held captive by him to carry out his purposes.

verses.heading: Difficult Times in the Last Days / Difficult Times in the Last Days
verses.text: You must grasp this truth clearly: During the concluding era of human history there will be periods characterized by extreme difficulty and dangerous conditions.

For people will be entirely absorbed in love for themselves and obsessed with accumulating wealth, they will be characterized by arrogant boasting and haughty pride, they will engage in blasphemous speech and slander, they will show rebellious disobedience toward their parents, they will lack gratitude, and they will have no regard for what is holy.

They will be devoid of natural family affection, they will refuse to make peace or reach agreements, they will spread false and slanderous accusations, they will have no ability to exercise self-control, they will be savage and cruel in disposition, and they will hate what is morally good.

They will betray confidences and commitments, they will act rashly without thinking, they will be puffed up with conceit and self-importance, they will be devoted to pursuing pleasurable experiences rather than being devoted to God,

they will maintain an external form or appearance of godly religion while having rejected and denied the power that could genuinely transform them. You must avoid such people and keep yourself separate from them.

For within this category are those who use cunning methods to enter into households and manipulate weak-willed women who are weighed down by accumulated sins and controlled by all kinds of passions and cravings,
women who are perpetually learning new teachings yet never capable of coming to full and accurate knowledge of the truth.

In the same manner that Jannes and Jambres stood in opposition to Moses, these individuals also stand against the truth. They are people whose minds have become morally corrupted and perverted, and regarding genuine faith they have failed the test and been rejected as counterfeit.

However, they will not continue to make headway in their deception, for their senseless foolishness will become completely obvious and apparent to everyone, just as happened with those two magicians who opposed Moses.

verses.heading: The Man of God and the Scripture / The Man of God and the Scripture
verses.text: But you have followed closely and traced carefully my teaching, my manner of life, my resolute purpose, my faith and trust, my patience under trial, my love, my steadfast endurance,

along with the persecutions and the sufferings that I experienced in Antioch, in Iconium, and in Lystra. You witnessed firsthand what severe persecutions I endured, yet from every one of them the Lord brought me safely through to deliverance.
In fact, all those who are determined to live lives characterized by godliness in union with Christ Jesus will experience persecution and opposition.
But evil individuals and fraudulent imposters will proceed from bad conditions to worse, leading others into error while they themselves are being led astray.

As for you, however, you must continue to stand firm in the truths you have learned and have become fully convinced of, keeping in mind the trustworthy character of the people from whom you learned these things,

and bearing in mind that from your earliest childhood you have had knowledge of the sacred writings, which possess the power to make you wise and lead you to salvation through the faith that is placed in Christ Jesus.

All Scripture originates from God’s own breath, and it serves a beneficial purpose for teaching, for exposing and refuting error, for correcting what is wrong, and for providing training and discipline in living a righteous life,
so that the man of God may be brought to perfection or complete maturity, fully equipped for the accomplishment of every kind of good work.

verses.heading: Preach the Word / Preach the Word
verses.text: I charge you in the sight of God and of Christ Jesus, who will one day serve as judge over those who are living and those who have died, and I charge you in view of His future appearance and His coming kingdom:

Proclaim the message of God’s word with urgency and persistence. Maintain readiness to minister whether the circumstances appear opportune or inopportune. Use the Scriptures to expose and refute error, to issue strong warnings against sin, and to appeal for obedience, always exercising great patience and providing thorough instruction.

For the time is approaching when people will refuse to put up with or tolerate wholesome teaching that promotes spiritual health. Rather, motivated by their own selfish desires and cravings, they will accumulate for themselves a multitude of teachers who will say precisely what their itching ears want to hear,
and they will deliberately turn their attention away from the truth and will allow themselves to be led off course toward myths and fabricated tales.

But as for you, maintain sober judgment and self-control under all circumstances. Be willing to accept and endure hardship. Perform the work that an evangelist does in proclaiming the gospel. Carry through to completion all the responsibilities of your ministry.

verses.heading: Paul Finishes the Race / Paul Finishes the Race
verses.text: For my own life is already in the process of being poured out like a drink offering on an altar, and the time of my departure from this life has arrived and stands near.

I have fought the good fight with courage and determination, I have run the entire race that was set before me and reached the finish line, and I have kept and maintained the faith that was entrusted to me.

From this time forward there is reserved and waiting for me the victor’s crown that is awarded on the basis of righteousness, which the Lord, who judges with perfect justice, will present to me on that final day, and He will give it not only to me but to all those who have loved and eagerly anticipated His appearing.

verses.heading: Paul Abandoned / Paul Abandoned
verses.text: Do everything within your power to come to me quickly and without delay.

For Demas has abandoned me because he fell in love with this present world system and its attractions, and he has traveled to Thessalonica. Crescens has departed for Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
Luke is the only one who remains here with me at present. Take Mark and bring him along with you when you come, for he proves himself useful and helpful to me in carrying out the work of ministry.
I have sent Tychicus to the city of Ephesus on a mission.
When you make your journey here, bring with you the heavy cloak that I left behind in Troas with Carpus, and also bring the scrolls containing Scripture, but especially bring the parchment documents.
Alexander, the worker in metal, inflicted much harm and injury upon me. The Lord will render to him the recompense his actions deserve.
You also should be on your guard concerning him, for he vigorously resisted our teaching.
When I made my first defense before the Roman authorities, not a single person came to stand beside me in support, but instead everyone abandoned me. May this failure not be charged against them.

verses.heading: Paul’s Confidence in the Lord / Paul’s Confidence in the Lord
verses.text: But the Lord took His position at my side and infused me with strength, so that through my testimony the proclamation of the gospel might be brought to full completion and all the Gentile nations might have the opportunity to hear it. And in this manner I was rescued out of the lion’s mouth and from mortal danger.
The Lord will continue to rescue me from every scheme of evil, and He will preserve me safely for entrance into His heavenly kingdom. To Him belongs the glory throughout all the ages to come. Amen.

verses.heading: Final Greetings / Final Greetings
verses.text: Extend my greetings to Prisca and Aquila, and to all those who belong to the household of Onesiphorus.
Erastus has remained in the city of Corinth, but I was compelled to leave Trophimus behind in Miletus because he had fallen sick with illness.
Make every effort to arrive here before the winter season sets in. Eubulus sends his greetings to you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers and sisters here.
May the Lord be present with your spirit. May grace be with all of you.

verses.heading: Greeting / Greeting
verses.text: Paul, a bondservant who belongs to God and an apostle commissioned by Jesus Christ, writing for the purpose of strengthening and advancing the faith of those whom God has chosen and promoting the knowledge of truth that leads to godly living,
based upon the confident expectation of eternal life, which God, who is incapable of falsehood, pledged and promised before the ages began,
but at the divinely appointed moment He revealed His word through the public proclamation that was committed to my trust by the direct commandment of God our Savior;
To Titus, my true spiritual son who shares a common faith with me: May you experience grace and peace from God the Father and from Christ Jesus our Savior.

verses.heading: Qualifications of Elders / Qualifications of Elders
verses.text: The reason I left you behind in Crete was so that you might complete the work that remains to be done and appoint elders in each town and city, following the instructions I gave you—
selecting only those who are above reproach, married to one wife, whose children are believers and are not open to charges of wild living or of being uncontrollable.

For it is essential that an overseer be blameless in character, since he serves as a steward entrusted with God’s household. He must not be self-willed, not prone to outbursts of anger, not given to excessive drinking, not violent or quick to use physical force, not pursuing profit through dishonest means,

but instead he must show hospitality, he must have a love for what is good and excellent, he must exercise self-control and sound judgment, he must act with justice, he must be holy in his conduct, he must be disciplined in his habits,

holding firmly to the reliable word that is consistent with the apostolic teaching, so that he will have the ability both to encourage others with instruction that promotes spiritual health and to refute those who oppose the truth.

For there exist many people who refuse to submit to authority—people who speak empty and meaningless words and who deceive others—and this is especially true of those who come from the circumcision party,
who must have their mouths stopped, since they are overturning entire families by teaching things they have no right to teach, all for the sake of gaining money through disgraceful means.
One of their own number, a prophet who belongs to them, has made this statement: “Cretans are habitual liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”
This testimony is true. For this very reason, rebuke them with sharpness, so that they may become sound and healthy in their faith,
and stop paying attention to Jewish myths and to the regulations of people who have turned their backs on the truth.
To those who are pure, all things are pure; but to those who are corrupted, nothing is pure, for both their minds and their consciences have been polluted.
They make the claim that they know God, but by their actions they utterly deny Him, proving themselves to be abhorrent and disobedient, disqualified for any good work.

verses.heading: Teaching Sound Doctrine / Teaching Sound Doctrine
verses.text: But as for you, communicate the things that are in harmony with teaching that promotes spiritual health and soundness.
Older men should be temperate, dignified in conduct, self-controlled in their behavior, and sound and healthy in their faith, in their love, and in their patient endurance.

In the same way, older women should conduct themselves in a manner that is reverent in their behavior, not spreading malicious slander, not becoming enslaved to drinking large quantities of wine, but instead teaching what is good and excellent,
so that they may instruct the younger women to be devoted in their love to their husbands and to their children,

to exercise self-control, to maintain purity, to be diligent workers who care for their homes, to be kind and good, to place themselves under the authority of their own husbands, so that the message of God will not be spoken against with blasphemy and insult.
In a similar manner, urge the younger men to exercise sound judgment and self-control;
in every situation demonstrate yourself to be a pattern of good works, showing in your teaching that you possess integrity and have not been corrupted, maintaining dignity and seriousness,
and using speech that is sound and healthy and cannot be condemned, so that anyone who stands in opposition may be put to shame, having no evil thing to say about us.
Slaves must place themselves in submission to their own masters in every respect, seeking to please them well, not talking back or being argumentative,
not stealing their possessions, but demonstrating complete and unwavering faithfulness, so that in every way they may make the teaching about God our Savior appealing.

verses.heading: The Instructing Grace / The Instructing Grace
verses.text: For the grace of God has made its appearance, bringing the offer of salvation to all people without distinction,
training and disciplining us so that, having rejected ungodliness and worldly passions and cravings, we might live in the present age with self-control, with righteousness, and with godly devotion,
while we wait with eager anticipation for the blessed hope and the glorious manifestation of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

who surrendered Himself as a sacrifice for our sake in order to purchase our redemption from every form of lawlessness, and to purify for Himself a people who are His special possession, a people who are passionate for doing good works.
Declare these truths, and urge people to obey them, and correct those who fail to comply, doing so with full authority. Allow no one to treat you with contempt or disregard.

verses.heading: Submission to Governing Authorities / Submission to Governing Authorities
verses.text: Keep reminding them to place themselves in submission to those who rule and to those in positions of authority, to obey their directives, to be prepared and ready for every kind of good work,
to speak slanderously about no one, to be peaceable and not quarrelsome, to show gentleness and courtesy, and to demonstrate complete considerateness toward all people.

verses.heading: The Grace of God and Good Works / The Grace of God and Good Works
verses.text: For we ourselves were once characterized by foolishness, by disobedience, by being deceived, by being enslaved to a variety of cravings and pleasures, by spending our lives in malicious spite and envy, by being hateful and detestable, and by hating one another.
But when the kindness and the love for humanity that belong to God our Savior were made manifest,

He saved us, not on the basis of righteous deeds that we ourselves had performed, but in accordance with His own mercy, through the cleansing bath of regeneration and the renewing work of the Holy Spirit,
whom He poured out upon us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,
so that, having been justified or declared righteous by His grace, we might become heirs who possess the confident expectation of eternal life.

This statement is worthy of trust, and concerning these truths, I want you to speak with strong emphasis, so that those who have placed their faith in God may be careful to apply themselves diligently to good works. These practices are excellent and beneficial for people.

verses.heading: Final Instructions and Greetings / Final Instructions and Greetings
verses.text: But stay away from foolish controversies, genealogies, contentions, and quarrels concerning the Law, for they accomplish nothing useful and are worthless.
After giving a first and second warning to a person who causes divisions, have nothing more to do with him,
recognizing that such an individual has become twisted in character and continues in sin, standing condemned by his own judgment of himself.
When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your utmost to come to me in Nicopolis, for I have made the decision to spend the winter season there.
Help Zenas the expert in law and Apollos on their journey, making sure they lack nothing they need.
And let our people also learn to commit themselves to good works that meet pressing needs, so that they will not live fruitless lives.
All those who are with me send their greetings to you. Give greetings to those who love us in the faith. May grace be with all of you.

verses.heading: Greeting / Greeting
verses.text: Paul, a prisoner held in custody because of Christ Jesus, together with Timothy our brother, To Philemon, our beloved friend and fellow worker in the gospel,
and to Apphia our sister, and to Archippus our fellow soldier in the faith, and to the church that gathers for worship in your house:
May grace and peace be yours from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.heading: Pauline Prayer / Pauline Prayer
verses.text: I express thanks to my God at all times, bringing you to remembrance whenever I pray,
because I continue to hear reports of the love you show and of the faith you possess toward the Lord Jesus and toward all those who belong to Him as saints.

I pray that the partnership and fellowship that comes from your faith may become powerful and effective as you come to fully recognize every good thing that is present within us for the sake of Christ.
For I have experienced great joy and received much encouragement from your love, because the hearts of God’s people have been given rest and refreshment through your ministry, my brother.

verses.heading: Paul’s Plea for Onesimus / Paul’s Plea for Onesimus
verses.text: For this reason, although I possess great freedom and boldness in Christ to command you to do what is fitting and appropriate,
yet because of love I would rather make an appeal to you—I, Paul, who am such a person as an old man, and now in addition am a prisoner held in custody for Christ Jesus.
I am making this appeal to you concerning my spiritual child, who became my son during the time of my imprisonment, namely Onesimus,
who in former times was useless and unprofitable to you but now has become useful and profitable both to you and to me.
I am sending him back to you in person—that is, I am sending back to you the one who is my very heart and affection.
I would have preferred to keep him here with me, so that in your place he might render service to me during my imprisonment for the sake of the gospel.

But I chose not to take any action without first obtaining your consent and agreement, so that the good deed you do would not result from compulsion or obligation but would flow from your own voluntary willingness.
For perhaps the reason he was separated from you for a short time was so that you might have him back permanently and forever,

no longer in the status and relationship of a slave, but as something far better than a slave—as a beloved brother, especially dear to me; but how much more valuable to you, both in the natural human relationship and in your relationship in the Lord.
So if you regard me as your partner and companion in the faith, welcome and receive him in the same way you would welcome and receive me.
But if he has caused you any harm or injury in any way or if he owes you anything, put that on my account and charge it to me.
I, Paul, am writing this promise with my own hand: I will repay it in full—not even mentioning to you that you are indebted to me for your very own self and life.
Yes indeed, my brother, let me receive some benefit and advantage from you in the Lord; give refreshment to my heart in Christ.
Having full confidence in your obedience to what is right, I am writing to you, knowing with certainty that you will do even more than what I am suggesting and requesting.
And at the same time, prepare a place of lodging for me as a guest, for I am hopeful that through the prayers you offer I will be graciously granted to you and restored to your presence.

verses.heading: Final Greetings / Final Greetings
verses.text: Epaphras, who is a fellow prisoner with me in Christ Jesus, sends his greetings to you,
as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who are my fellow workers in the ministry.
May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be present with your spirit.

verses.heading: God’s Final Word through His Son / God’s Final Word through His Son
verses.text: In the past, God spoke to our fathers through the prophets in many portions and in a variety of ways,
but in these last days He has spoken to us through His Son, whom He appointed as the heir of all things and through whom He also brought the entire created order into existence.

He is the radiant outshining of God’s glory and the exact imprint of His very being, and He sustains all things by His powerful word. After accomplishing the cleansing of sins, He took His seat at the right hand of the supreme Majesty in heaven,
having become far superior to the angels, just as the name He has received is far more excellent than theirs.

verses.heading: The Supremacy of the Son over the Angels / The Supremacy of the Son over the Angels
verses.text: For to which of the angels did God ever say, “You are My Son; today I have brought You forth?”* And again, “I will be a Father to Him, and He will be a Son to Me?”*
And again, when God brings His firstborn into the world, He declares, “Let all the angels of God worship Him.”*
With reference to the angels, He says, “He makes His angels swift as winds, and His servants like a flame of fire.”*
But with reference to the Son, He says, “Your throne, O God, stands forever and ever, and the scepter of righteousness is the scepter of Your kingdom.
You have loved what is right and hated lawlessness; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You with the oil of gladness above Your companions.”*
And He also says, “You, Lord, laid the foundation of the earth at the beginning, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment.
Like a robe You will roll them up, and like clothing they will be changed. But You remain the same, and Your years will never come to an end.”*
And to which of the angels has He ever said, “Sit at My right hand until I place Your enemies as a footstool for Your feet?”*

verses.heading: Notes / Notes
verses.text: Are not all the angels ministering spirits, sent out by God to serve on behalf of those who are destined to inherit salvation? 5 Quoted from Ps. 2:7 5 Quoted from 2 Sam. 7:14; 1 Chr. 17:13; cf. Ps. 89:26-27 6 Quoted from the Septuagint of Deut. 32:43; cf. Ps. 97:7 7 Quoted from Ps. 104:4 8-9 Quoted from Ps. 45:6-7 10-12 Quoted from Ps. 102:25-27 13 Quoted from Ps. 110:1

verses.heading: Warning Against Neglecting Salvation / Warning Against Neglecting Salvation
verses.text: For this reason, we must pay much closer attention to what we have heard, so that we do not slowly drift away from it.
For if the message delivered through angels proved firm and binding, and every violation and act of disobedience received a deserved judgment,
how will we escape if we treat with indifference a salvation of such magnitude? This salvation was first proclaimed by the Lord Himself and was later confirmed to us by those who heard Him directly.
God Himself also testified alongside them, confirming the message by signs, wonders, various mighty works, and by sovereignly distributing the gifts of the Holy Spirit according to His own will.

verses.heading: The Son Made Lower than Angels / The Son Made Lower than Angels
verses.text: For God has not given authority over the world to come—the world we are discussing—to angelic beings.
Instead, Scripture records someone declaring, “What is man that You hold him in Your mind, or the son of man that You attend to him?
You made him temporarily below the angels in rank; You placed upon him a crown representing glory and honor.
You put all things under his feet.”* When God put everything under his control, He excluded nothing from this authority. Yet in our current situation, we do not yet see everything under his control.
