Yet Balaam was exposed for his own lawlessness when a mute animal spoke with a human voice and restrained the prophet’s reckless madness.
These people offer nothing of substance—like springs with no water or clouds driven aimlessly by violent winds. What has been kept for them is the deepest darkness.
With inflated and empty speech, they entice people through sensual desires of the flesh—those who are only just breaking free from those who live in deception.
They hold out the promise of freedom, yet they themselves are trapped in decay and moral slavery, since a person becomes enslaved to whatever gains mastery over them.

For if people escape the corruption of the world by coming to know the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, and then become entangled again and overpowered by it, their condition at the end is worse than it was at the beginning.
It would have been better for them never to have come to know the path of righteousness than, after knowing it, to turn away from the holy commandment entrusted to them.

verses.heading: Notes / Notes
verses.text: What has happened to them fits the old proverb perfectly: “A dog goes back to its vomit,” and “A pig that has been washed returns to wallowing in filth.* 22 Quoted from Prov. 26:11

verses.heading: The Eschatological Day of the Lord / The Eschatological Day of the Lord
verses.text: Beloved, this is now the second time I have written to you. In both letters my aim has been to awaken your pure mind by calling certain truths back to your mind.
I want you to keep in view what was spoken earlier by the holy prophets, as well as the authoritative instruction of the Lord and Savior that came to you through your apostles.
Above all, you must recognize that as history moves toward its final stage, people will appear who scoff openly, advancing according to their own inordinate desires,
and who say, “So where is this promised return of Christ? Ever since our ancestors died, everything has gone on exactly the same way it has since the world first began.”
What they deliberately overlook is this: Long ago the heavens came into being, and the earth was shaped by the word of God out of water and through water,
and by those same waters the world that then existed was overwhelmed and destroyed.

By that very same divine word, the present heavens and earth are now being held in reserve, stored up not for water but for fire, awaiting the day when God judges and brings final ruin upon the ungodly.

But do not miss this crucial point, beloved: God’s experience of time is not like ours. What seems to us like a single day may be as long as a thousand years to Him, and a thousand years no more than a day.

The Lord is not failing to keep His promise, as some imagine when they accuse Him of delay. Rather, He is showing patience toward you, because He does not want anyone to be destroyed, but wants all to turn back to Him in repentance.

Nevertheless, the day of the Lord will arrive unexpectedly, like a thief. When it comes, the heavens will disappear with a deafening roar, the components of the universe will be destroyed by intense heat, and the earth together with everything done on it will be laid bare.
Since all of creation is going to be destroyed in this way, consider what kind of lives you ought to live—lives marked by holiness and godliness,

as you look forward to the day of God and even live in a way that hastens its arrival. Because of that day, the heavens will be set ablaze and dissolved, and the elements will melt away in burning heat.
Yet in keeping with the promise of God, we are waiting with confidence for new heavens and a new earth—where righteousness is fully at home.
For this reason, beloved, as you await these things, make every effort to be found by Him spotless, unblemished, and at peace.
You should understand the patience of our Lord as part of His saving purpose, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote to you, according to the wisdom God gave him.

He speaks about these matters throughout his letters. Some of what he says is difficult to grasp, and people who are ignorant and spiritually unstable twist his words—just as they do the rest of Scripture—to their own ruin.
Since you already know these things, beloved, be on your guard so that you are not swept along by the deception of lawless people and lose your firm footing.
Instead, continue to grow—grow in the grace that comes from Christ and in the true knowledge of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ. To Him belongs the glory now and into the endless future. Amen.

verses.heading: Prologue: Concerning the Word of Life / Prologue: Concerning the Word of Life
verses.text: We are declaring to you what existed from the very beginning—what we have heard with our own ears, what we have witnessed with our own eyes, what we have gazed upon intently, and what our own hands have physically touched—concerning the Word who gives life.
The life appeared, and we have seen and now bear witness and proclaim to you the eternal life, which existed in the Father’s presence and was revealed to us.
What we ourselves have seen and heard, we now proclaim to you as well, so that you may share in our fellowship. And truly, our fellowship is with the Father and with His Son Jesus Christ.
We are writing these things so that our joy may be completely fulfilled.

verses.heading: Walking in the Light / Walking in the Light
verses.text: Here is the message we have received from Him and now announce to you: God is pure Light, and in Him there exists absolutely no darkness whatsoever.
If we claim to have fellowship with Him while continuing to walk in darkness, we are lying and not living according to the truth.
But if we walk in the Light just as He exists in the Light, we have genuine fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son continuously cleanses us from every sin.
If we claim to be without sin, we are deceiving ourselves, and the truth has no place in us.
If we acknowledge our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from every form of unrighteousness.
If we claim we have never sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word has no place in us.

verses.heading: Christ, our Advocate with the Father / Christ, our Advocate with the Father
verses.text: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. Yet if anyone does commit sin, we have One who speaks in our defense before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
He Himself is the propitiation for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the entire world.
We can be sure that we have come to know Him if we obey His commands.
Anyone who claims, “I have come to know Him,” yet fails to obey His commands is a liar, and the truth is not present in that person.
But whoever obeys His word—in that person the love of God has genuinely reached its full expression. This is how we can be certain we are united with Him:
Anyone who claims to remain in Him must conduct himself in the same manner as Jesus conducted Himself.

verses.heading: The New Commandment / The New Commandment
verses.text: Beloved, I am not writing you a new commandment, but rather an old commandment that you have possessed from the beginning. This old commandment is the message you have already heard.
Yet I am writing to you what is in another sense a new commandment, which proves itself true in Him and in you, because the darkness is fading away and the true Light is already shining.
Anyone who claims to be in the Light yet harbors hatred toward his brother remains in darkness to this very moment.
The person who loves his brother lives in the Light, and there is nothing in him that would cause him to stumble.
But the person who hates his brother exists in darkness and walks in darkness, and he has no idea where he is going because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
I am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven on account of His name.
I am writing to you, fathers, because you have known the One who has existed from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have conquered the evil one.

I have written to you, children, because you have known the Father. I have written to you, fathers, because you have known the One who has existed from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are spiritually strong, the word of God lives in you, and you have conquered the evil one.

verses.heading: Do not Love the World / Do not Love the World
verses.text: Do not love the world system or anything belonging to the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not present in him.

For everything that exists in the world—the sinful cravings of our flesh, the greedy desires of our eyes, and the arrogant pride in our possessions—does not come from the Father but originates from the world.
The world and its lustful desires are passing away, but the person who does the will of God lives forever.

verses.heading: The Last Hour / The Last Hour
verses.text: Children, this is the final hour, and just as you have heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have appeared, which confirms for us that this is indeed the last hour.

They departed from our fellowship, but they never truly belonged to us. For if they had genuinely belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But their departure made it evident that none of them truly belonged to us.
But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you possess knowledge.
I have not written to you because you lack knowledge of the truth, but rather because you do possess it, and because no lie originates from the truth.
Who is the liar if not the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist—the one who denies both the Father and the Son.
Everyone who denies the Son does not have the Father either; the person who acknowledges the Son has the Father as well.

As for you, let what you heard from the beginning continue to live in you. If what you heard from the beginning continues to live in you, you will also continue to live in union with the Son and the Father.
And this is the promise He Himself gave us—eternal life.
I have written these things to you concerning those who are trying to lead you astray.

But as for you, the anointing you received from Him continues to live in you, and you have no need for anyone to teach you. Rather, since His anointing instructs you about all things, and since it is genuine and not counterfeit, remain in Him just as it has instructed you.

verses.heading: Confidence Before God / Confidence Before God
verses.text: And now, little children, remain in Him, so that when He appears we may have confidence and not shrink back in shame before Him at His coming.
If you recognize that He is righteous, you also recognize that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him.

verses.heading: Called as the Children of God / Called as the Children of God
verses.text: Consider what remarkable love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called the children of God—and that is exactly what we are! The reason the world does not recognize us is that it did not recognize Him.
Beloved, we are children of God right now, and what we will become has not yet been fully revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, because we will see Him exactly as He is.
Everyone who holds this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.

verses.heading: The Practice of Sin vs. the Practice of Righteousness / The Practice of Sin vs. the Practice of Righteousness
verses.text: Everyone who practices sin also practices lawlessness; indeed, sin is lawlessness.
You know that Christ appeared in order to take away sins, and in Him there is no sin whatsoever.

No one who continues to live in Him practices sin habitually. No one who habitually practices sin has truly seen Him or known Him. Little children, do not let anyone deceive you. The person who practices righteousness is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.

The person who habitually practices sin belongs to the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. The Son of God appeared for this very purpose: to destroy the works of the devil.
No one who has been born of God practices sin habitually, because God’s seed remains in him. He cannot continue in a pattern of sin, because he has been born of God.
This is how we can distinguish the children of God from the children of the devil: Anyone who does not practice righteousness does not belong to God, nor does anyone who fails to love his brother.

verses.heading: The Love of Brotherhood / The Love of Brotherhood
verses.text: For this is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another.
We must not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? Because his own actions were evil while his brother’s actions were righteous.
Do not be surprised, brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.
We know we have passed from death to life because we love our fellow believers. Anyone who does not love remains in death.
Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

verses.heading: The Practical Outworking of Love / The Practical Outworking of Love
verses.text: This is how we understand love: Christ laid down His life for our benefit, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers and sisters.
But if someone possesses material resources and sees his brother in need yet closes his heart against him, how can God’s love remain in that person?
Little children, let us not love merely with words or speech, but with actions and in truth.

verses.heading: The Spirit of Truth and the Spirit of Error / The Spirit of Truth and the Spirit of Error
verses.text: This is how we will know that we belong to the truth and will set our hearts at rest in His presence:
Even if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and He knows everything.
Beloved, if our heart does not condemn us, we have confidence in approaching God.
And we receive from Him whatever we ask, because we obey His commandments and do what pleases Him.
This is His commandment: that we believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, just as He commanded us.
Those who obey His commandments live in Him, and He in them. This is how we know that He lives in us: by the Spirit He gave us.

verses.heading: The Spirit of God and the Spirit of the Antichrist / The Spirit of God and the Spirit of the Antichrist
verses.text: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to determine whether they come from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
This is how you can recognize the Spirit of God: Every spirit that acknowledges that Jesus Christ has come in human flesh is from God,
and every spirit that does not acknowledge Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and even now is already in the world.
You, little children, belong to God and have overcome them, because the One who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.
They belong to the world and therefore speak from the world’s perspective, and the world listens to them.
We belong to God, and whoever knows God listens to us; whoever does not belong to God does not listen to us. This is how we recognize the Spirit of truth and the spirit of falsehood.

verses.heading: The Supremacy of God’s Love / The Supremacy of God’s Love
verses.text: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
This is how the love of God was revealed among us: God sent His only Son into the world so that we might live through Him.
This is what love is: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the propitiation for our sins.
Beloved, since God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God lives in us and His love is brought to full expression in us.
This is how we know that we live in Him and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.
And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent His Son to be the Savior of the world.
If anyone acknowledges that Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in him and he in God.
And so we have come to know and to believe the love God has for us. God is love, and whoever lives in love lives in God, and God lives in him.
In this way, love is brought to its full expression among us, so that we will have confidence on the day of judgment, because in this world we are like Jesus.
There is no fear in love. Instead, perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The person who is afraid has not been perfected in love.
We love because He first loved us.
If anyone claims, “I love God,” yet hates his brother, he is a liar. For whoever does not love his brother whom he has seen cannot love God whom he has not seen.
And He has given us this commandment: Whoever loves God must also love his brother.

verses.heading: Faith in the Son of God / Faith in the Son of God
verses.text: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father loves His child as well.
This is how we know that we love the children of God: When we love God and obey His commandments.
For this is what it means to love God: to obey His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome,
because everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
Who is it that overcomes the world? Only the person who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.

verses.heading: Testimony about Jesus / Testimony about Jesus
verses.text: This is the One who came by water and blood—Jesus Christ. He did not come by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
For there are three that testify:
the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and these three are in complete agreement.
If we accept human testimony, God's testimony is greater, because it is the testimony of God that He has given about His Son.
Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony in his heart. Whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because he has not believed the testimony God has given about His Son.
And this is the testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.

verses.heading: Assurance of Eternal Life and Prayer / Assurance of Eternal Life and Prayer
verses.text: I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God so that you may know that you have eternal life.
This is the confidence we have in approaching God: that if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
And if we know that He hears us—whatever we ask—we know that we have what we asked of Him.

verses.heading: The Sin Leading to Death and the Sin Not Leading to Death / The Sin Leading to Death and the Sin Not Leading to Death
verses.text: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin that does not lead to death, he should pray and God will give him life. I am referring to those whose sin does not lead to death. There is a sin that leads to death. I am not saying he should pray about that.
All unrighteousness is sin, but there is sin that does not lead to death.
We know that anyone born of God does not continue to sin; the One who was born of God keeps him safe, and the evil one cannot touch him.
We know that we are children of God, and that the whole world lies under the control of the evil one.

verses.heading: True God and Eternal Life / True God and Eternal Life
verses.text: We know also that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true. And we are in Him who is true by being in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
Little children, keep yourselves from idols.

verses.heading: Greeting / Greeting
verses.text: The Elder, To the elect lady and her children, whom I genuinely love in the truth—and not I alone, but all who have come to know the truth—
because of the truth that abides within us and will remain with us forever:
Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

verses.heading: Walking According to God’s Commandments / Walking According to God’s Commandments
verses.text: It brought me great joy to discover that some of your children are living according to the truth, just as we received commandment from the Father.
And now I appeal to you, dear lady—not as though I were writing a new commandment, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.
And this is what love means: that we live in obedience to His commandments. This is the commandment you have heard from the beginning, that you must live in love.

verses.heading: The Emergence of the Deceivers / The Emergence of the Deceivers
verses.text: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who do not confess Jesus Christ as having come in the flesh. Such a person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
Guard yourselves, so that you do not forfeit what we have labored for, but may receive a full reward.
Anyone who goes beyond the teaching of Christ and does not remain in it does not possess God. The one who remains in the teaching possesses both the Father and the Son.
If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home or offer him a greeting,
for the one who greets him participates in his evil deeds.

verses.heading: Farewell Greeting / Farewell Greeting
verses.text: Though I have many things to write to you, I do not wish to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come to you and speak face to face, so that our joy may be made complete.
The children of your elect sister send you their greetings.

verses.heading: Greeting / Greeting
verses.text: The Elder, To Gaius, my beloved, whom I sincerely love in the truth.
Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in every respect and remain in good health, just as your inner life is thriving.
I rejoiced greatly when brothers and sisters came and testified to your faithfulness to the truth, how you continue to live in accordance with it.
I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.

verses.heading: Commendation of Gaius / Commendation of Gaius
verses.text: Beloved, you are acting faithfully in all that you do for the brothers and sisters, even when they are strangers to you.
They have borne witness before the church to your love. You will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God.
For they went out for the sake of the Name, accepting nothing from unbelievers.
Therefore, we ought to support such people, so that we may become fellow workers for the truth.

verses.heading: Diotrephes and Demetrius / Diotrephes and Demetrius
verses.text: I wrote something to the church, but Diotrephes, who desires to put himself first, does not accept our authority.

For this reason, if I come, I will bring attention to his actions, how he spreads malicious accusations against us. Not content with this, he refuses to receive the brothers and sisters, and he hinders those who desire to do so, even expelling them from the church.
Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good belongs to God; the one who does evil has not seen God.
Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and even from the truth itself. We also bear witness to him, and you know that our testimony is true.

verses.heading: Farewell Greeting / Farewell Greeting
verses.text: I have many things to write to you, but I do not wish to write them with pen and ink.
Instead, I hope to see you soon, and we will speak face to face.
Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends there individually by name.

verses.heading: Greeting / Greeting
verses.text: Jude, a servant wholly devoted to Jesus Christ and a brother of James. To those whom God has called—loved in God the Father and are kept safe for Jesus Christ.
May mercy, peace, and love overflow more and more in your lives.

verses.heading: A Call to Defend the Faith / A Call to Defend the Faith
verses.text: Beloved, although I had hoped to write to you about the salvation we all share, I found it necessary to write instead with an urgent appeal: You must earnestly and actively contend for the faith that God entrusted once for all to the saints.

The reason is this—certain individuals have quietly slipped in among you. Long ago their judgment was already announced. They live without reverence for God, twisting His grace into an excuse for moral corruption, and in doing so they deny Jesus Christ, who alone is our rightful Master and Lord.

verses.heading: Examples of Divine Judgment / Examples of Divine Judgment
verses.text: Though you already know these things, I want to remind you: After Jesus delivered His people out of the land of Egypt, He later brought destruction upon those who refused to trust Him.

Likewise, the angels who did not remain within the authority assigned to them, but abandoned the place God had given them, He has kept under restraint in darkness, bound until the judgment of the great Day.

In the same way, Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding towns surrendered themselves to sexual corruption and unnatural desire. They now stand as a warning, having undergone the punishment of eternal fire.

verses.heading: The Character of the False Teachers / The Character of the False Teachers
verses.text: These people follow the same pattern. Guided by their delusions, they corrupt their own bodies, reject rightful authority, and insult glorious ones.
Yet even Michael the archangel, when he contended with the devil over the body of Moses, did not dare to pronounce a slanderous judgment. Instead, he said, “The Lord rebuke you.”

But these individuals pour contempt on things they do not understand at all. The limited knowledge they possess derives solely from natural impulse, as with irrational beasts—and precisely this instinctual understanding serves as the instrument of their destruction.
How terrible their end will be. They have chosen the way of Cain, thrown themselves into Balaam’s error for the sake of profit, and destroyed themselves in rebellion like Korah.

These constitute concealed reefs in your love feasts, banqueting alongside you shamelessly. They are shepherds who look after only themselves. They are like clouds that promise rain but deliver nothing, like fruitless autumn trees—pulled up by the roots and twice dead.
They are violent waves of the sea, churning up the shame of their own lives. They are wandering stars, for whom the deepest darkness has been permanently reserved.

verses.heading: Prophetic Condemnation / Prophetic Condemnation
verses.text: Long ago Enoch, the seventh from Adam, spoke prophetically about such people, saying, “Look—the Lord is coming with countless holy ones,

to carry out judgment against everyone and to expose every godless person for all the ungodly acts they have committed in defiance of Him, and for all the harsh words that rebellious sinners have spoken against Him.”*

These people are chronic grumblers, constantly dissatisfied, advancing according to their own inordinate desires. They speak with inflated arrogance and use flattery when it serves their own advantage.

verses.heading: Final Exhortations / Final Exhortations
verses.text: But you, beloved, must remember what was foretold by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
They warned you that “In the last time there would be scoffers who live according to their own godless cravings.”
These are the people who cause divisions. They operate on natural impulse alone and do not possess the Spirit.
But you, beloved, by continuing to build yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying under the direction of the Holy Spirit,
remain firmly anchored in God’s love as you await the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ that leads to eternal life.
Show compassion to those who are unsure and wavering.
Rescue others by pulling them back from the brink of destruction. And toward others, show mercy with caution—hating even the traces of sin that cling to them.

verses.heading: Doxology / Doxology
verses.text: Now to the One who is able to protect you from stumbling and to bring you into His glorious presence without fault and with overwhelming joy,

verses.heading: Notes / Notes
verses.text: to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord—to Him belong glory, majesty, power, and authority before all time, now, and for all eternity. Amen. 14-15 The quotation originates in 1 Enoch 1:9, a Jewish apocalyptic text commonly dated to the first century B.C

verses.heading: Prologue and Doxology / Prologue and Doxology
verses.text: This is the revelation given by Jesus Christ, which God granted to Him so He could show His servants what must happen shortly. Christ communicated this revelation by sending His angel to His servant John,
who has borne witness to God’s word and to the testimony about Jesus Christ—everything he witnessed.
Blessed is the person who reads these words, and blessed are those who hear this prophetic message and obey what is written here, for the appointed time is drawing near.

verses.heading: Greeting and Doxology / Greeting and Doxology
verses.text: John, writing to the seven congregations throughout the province of Asia: May you experience grace and peace from the One who exists eternally—who is present now, who existed in the past, and who will come in the future; and from the seven Spirits stationed before His throne;

and from Jesus Christ, the trustworthy witness, the firstborn from among the dead, and the supreme ruler over all earthly kings. To Him who demonstrates His love for us and has liberated us from our sins through the shedding of His blood,
and has constituted us as a kingdom of priests serving His God and Father—to Him belong all glory and dominion throughout eternity. Amen.

Pay attention. He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will observe Him, including those who pierced Him through with a spear, and all the ethnic groups of the earth will beat their chests in mourning because of Him. This is certain. Amen.

“I am the Alpha and the Omega—the origin and the goal of all things,” declares the Lord God, “the One who exists eternally—who is present now, who existed in the past, and who will come in the future—the Almighty.”

verses.heading: Vision of the Son of Man / Vision of the Son of Man
verses.text: I, John, am your brother and companion in the persecution, the kingdom, and the patient endurance that belong to us through our union with Jesus. I found myself on the island named Patmos because I had proclaimed God’s word and maintained my testimony about Jesus.
I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day when I heard behind me a thunderous voice like a trumpet blast
announcing, “Write what you observe in a scroll and dispatch it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, to Smyrna, to Pergamum, to Thyatira, to Sardis, to Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”
I turned around to identify the source of the voice addressing me, and when I turned I observed seven lampstands made of gold.
Moving among the lampstands was someone resembling a human figure, wearing a full-length robe with a golden sash wrapped around His chest.
His head and hair shone with brilliant whiteness like pure wool or fresh snow, and His eyes blazed like flames of fire.
His feet gleamed like bronze that has been purified in a smelting furnace, and His voice thundered like the roar of many waters.
He held seven stars in His right hand, and a sharp sword with two edges emerged from His mouth, and His face radiated brilliance like the sun shining at its peak intensity.
When I saw Him, I collapsed at His feet as though lifeless. But He placed His right hand on me and said, “Stop being afraid. I am the First and the Last,
the Living One. I experienced death, but observe—I am alive forevermore, and I possess the keys of death and of Hades.
Therefore write down what you have witnessed, both the present realities and the future events that will unfold.

Concerning the mystery of the seven stars you observed in My right hand and the seven golden lampstands: the seven stars represent the angels or messengers of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands represent the seven churches themselves.

verses.heading: To the Church in Ephesus / To the Church in Ephesus
verses.text: “To the angel or messenger of the church in Ephesus, write: “These are the declarations of the One who grips the seven stars securely in His right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands:

‘I have complete knowledge of your deeds—your exhausting labor and your steadfast endurance. I know you cannot tolerate those who practice evil. You have examined those who falsely claim apostolic authority, and you have exposed them as impostors.
You have demonstrated perseverance and have endured suffering on account of My name without growing weary.
‘Nevertheless, I hold this charge against you: You have abandoned the fervent love you displayed at first.

Remember the height from which you have fallen. Repent, and resume doing the works you did initially. But if you refuse, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its position—unless you repent.
Yet you do possess this commendable quality: You detest the practices of the Nicolaitans, which I also detest.

‘Let anyone who has ears pay close attention to what the Spirit is declaring to the churches. To the person who conquers, I will grant authorization to eat from the tree of life standing in God’s paradise.’

verses.heading: To the Church in Smyrna / To the Church in Smyrna
verses.text: “To the angel or messenger of the church in Smyrna, write: “These are the declarations of the First and the Last, who died and returned to life:

‘I have full knowledge of your tribulation and your material poverty—though spiritually you are wealthy. I know about the slander hurled at you by those who claim to be Jews but are not genuine Jews; rather, they constitute a synagogue under Satan’s influence.

Do not fear what you are about to endure. Pay attention. The devil is preparing to cast some of you into prison to test your faithfulness, and you will experience tribulation for ten days. Remain faithful all the way to death, and I will bestow upon you the victor’s crown of life.
‘Let anyone who has ears pay close attention to what the Spirit is declaring to the churches. The person who conquers will suffer no harm whatsoever from the second death.’

verses.heading: To the Church in Pergamum / To the Church in Pergamum
verses.text: “To the angel or messenger of the church in Pergamum, write: “These are the declarations of the One who wields the sharp sword with two edges:

‘I have full knowledge of where you dwell—in the very location where Satan has established his throne. Yet you cling firmly to My name and did not renounce your faith in Me, even during the time when Antipas, My faithful witness, was martyred among you, in the place where Satan resides.

However, I have a few complaints against you: You have some members there who embrace the teaching of Balaam, who instructed Balak how to cause the Israelites to stumble by enticing them to eat food sacrificed to idols and to engage in sexual immorality.
Likewise, you have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
Therefore repent. But if you refuse, I will come to you swiftly and will make war against them using the sword that comes from My mouth.

‘Let anyone who has ears pay close attention to what the Spirit is declaring to the churches. To the person who conquers, I will give a portion of the hidden manna. I will also give that person a white stone inscribed with a new name that no one understands except the one who receives it.’

verses.heading: To the Church in Thyatira / To the Church in Thyatira
verses.text: “To the angel or messenger of the church in Thyatira, write: “These are the declarations of the Son of God, whose eyes blaze like flames of fire and whose feet gleam like refined bronze:
‘I have full knowledge of your deeds—your love, your faith, your service, and your patient endurance. I know that your recent deeds surpass your earlier ones.

Nevertheless, I hold this charge against you: You are permitting that woman Jezebel, who designates herself a prophetess, to teach and seduce My servants into committing sexual immorality and eating food sacrificed to idols.
I have granted her time to repent, but she refuses to turn away from her sexual immorality.
Take notice. I am about to throw her onto a bed of anguish, and I will plunge those who commit adultery with her into severe tribulation, unless they repent of their participation in her deeds.

I will strike her followers dead with plague, and all the churches will recognize that I am the One who examines innermost thoughts and desires, and I will repay each of you according to your actions.
‘But to the rest of you in Thyatira—all of you who do not embrace this teaching and have not explored what some people call Satan’s deep secrets—I say that I will impose no additional burden on you.
However, hold tightly to what you possess until I arrive.
To the person who conquers and continues performing My works until the end, I will grant authority over the nations.
That person will rule them with an iron rod and will shatter them like clay pottery—exactly as I have received authority from My Father.
I will also give that person the morning star.
‘Let anyone who has ears pay close attention to what the Spirit is declaring to the churches.’

verses.heading: To the Church in Sardis / To the Church in Sardis
verses.text: “To the angel or messenger of the church in Sardis, write: “These are the declarations of the One who possesses the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: ‘I have complete knowledge of your deeds. You possess a reputation for being spiritually alive, but in reality you are spiritually dead.
Awaken and fortify what little remains that is about to die, for I have determined that your deeds are incomplete in the sight of My God.

Remember what you originally received and heard; guard it carefully and repent. But if you fail to wake up, I will arrive like a thief, and you will have absolutely no idea at what hour I will come upon you.
‘Yet you have a few individuals in Sardis who have not contaminated their garments. They will walk alongside Me dressed in white because they have proven themselves worthy.

The person who conquers will similarly be clothed in white garments, and I will absolutely never erase that person’s name from the book of life. Rather, I will openly acknowledge that name in the presence of My Father and in the presence of His angels.
‘Let anyone who has ears pay close attention to what the Spirit is declaring to the churches.’

verses.heading: To the Church in Philadelphia / To the Church in Philadelphia
verses.text: “To the angel or messenger of the church in Philadelphia, write: “These are the declarations of the Holy One, the True One, who holds the key of David. What He opens, no one can close, and what He closes, no one can open:

‘I have complete knowledge of your deeds. Take notice! I have set before you an open door that no one has the power to close. I recognize that you possess only limited strength, yet you have obeyed My word and have not denied My name.

Pay attention! I will deal with those who belong to Satan’s synagogue—those who falsely claim to be Jews when they are actually lying—indeed, I will make them come and prostrate themselves at your feet and acknowledge that I have loved you.
Because you have obeyed My commandment to endure patiently, I will likewise protect you from the hour of testing that is about to come upon the entire world to test those who inhabit the earth.
‘I am coming soon. Grasp tightly what you possess, so that no one seizes your victor's crown.

The person who conquers I will establish as a pillar in the temple of My God, and that person will never depart from it again. I will inscribe on that person the name of My God and the name of the city of My God—the new Jerusalem descending out of heaven from My God—and My own new name.
‘Let anyone who has ears pay close attention to what the Spirit is declaring to the churches.’

verses.heading: To the Church in Laodicea / To the Church in Laodicea
verses.text: “To the angel or messenger of the church in Laodicea, write: “These are the declarations of the Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Source of God’s creation:
‘I have complete knowledge of your deeds—you are neither spiritually cold nor spiritually hot. I wish you were one or the other!
So because you are lukewarm, neither hot nor cold, I am about to vomit you out of My mouth.
‘You keep saying, “I am wealthy and have acquired riches and need nothing,” but you fail to realize that you are miserable, pitiful, poverty-stricken, blind, and naked.

I advise you to purchase from Me gold refined through fire so that you may become genuinely wealthy, and white garments so that you may be properly clothed and the shameful exposure of your nakedness will not be revealed, and salve to apply to your eyes so that you may see clearly.
‘All those whom I love I correct and discipline. Therefore become zealous and repent.
Pay attention! I stand at the door knocking. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will enter and share a meal with that person, and that person with Me.
To the person who conquers, I will grant the privilege of sitting down with Me on My throne, just as I conquered and sat down with My Father on His throne.
‘Let anyone who has ears pay close attention to what the Spirit is declaring to the churches.’ ”

verses.heading: Vision of the Heavenly Throne / Vision of the Heavenly Throne
verses.text: After these things I looked, and there before me stood an open door in heaven. The first voice I had heard speaking to me like a trumpet said, “Come here, and I will reveal to you what must happen after these present events.”
Instantly I was in the Spirit, and there before me stood a throne in heaven with Someone seated on the throne.
The One sitting there had an appearance resembling jasper and carnelian stones, and encircling the throne was a rainbow with an appearance like emerald.
Surrounding that throne were twenty-four additional thrones, and seated on those thrones were twenty-four elders dressed in white garments with golden crowns on their heads.
From the throne emanated lightning flashes, rumblings, and peals of thunder. Seven blazing lamps were burning before the throne, which represent the seven Spirits of God.

Extending before the throne was something resembling a sea of glass, transparent as crystal. At the very center and surrounding the throne, were four living beings, covered with eyes both in front and behind.
The first living being resembled a lion, the second living being resembled an ox, the third living being possessed a face like a man, and the fourth living being resembled an eagle in flight.

Each of the four living beings had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and underneath. Day and night they never cease declaring, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty, who existed in the past, who exists now, and who will come in the future.”
Whenever the living beings ascribe glory, honor, and thanksgiving to the One seated on the throne—the One who lives throughout all the ages,
the twenty-four elders prostrate themselves before the One seated on the throne and worship the One who lives throughout all the ages. They cast their crowns before the throne and declare,
“You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things, and because of Your will they existed and were brought into being.”

verses.heading: The Lamb and the Scroll with Seven Seals / The Lamb and the Scroll with Seven Seals
verses.text: Then I observed in the right hand of the One seated on the throne a scroll with writing on both the inside and the back, sealed with seven seals.
I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a thunderous voice, “Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?”
But no one in heaven or on earth or beneath the earth had the power to open the scroll or examine its contents.
I began weeping profusely because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or examine it.
Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop weeping! Look—the Lion from the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has conquered and is therefore able to open the scroll and its seven seals.”

Then I saw standing in the center of the throne, surrounded by the four living beings and the elders, a Lamb that appeared as though it had been slaughtered. It possessed seven horns and seven eyes, which represent the seven Spirits of God dispatched into all the earth.
He approached and took the scroll from the right hand of the One seated on the throne.

When He had taken the scroll, the four living beings and the twenty-four elders prostrated themselves before the Lamb. Each one held a harp and golden bowls brimming with incense, which represent the prayers of the saints.

They sang a new song with these words: “You are worthy to take the scroll and to break its seals, because You were slaughtered, and with Your blood You purchased people for God from every tribe and language and people group and nation.
You have constituted them as a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will reign on the earth.”
Then I looked and heard the voices of countless angels encircling the throne, the living beings, and the elders. Their number was myriads upon myriads and thousands upon thousands.
They proclaimed in a mighty voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who was slaughtered to receive power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and praise!”

Then I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and beneath the earth and on the sea—all that exists within them—declaring: “To the One seated on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and dominion throughout all the ages!”
The four living beings responded, “Amen!” And the elders prostrated themselves and worshipped.

verses.heading: First Seal: The White Horse and the Conqueror / First Seal: The White Horse and the Conqueror
verses.text: I watched as the Lamb broke one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living beings say with a voice like thunder, “Come!”
I looked, and there before me appeared a white horse! Its rider carried a bow, and a crown was placed on his head. He rode out as a conqueror determined to conquer.

verses.heading: Second Seal: The Fiery Red Horse and the Destroyer / Second Seal: The Fiery Red Horse and the Destroyer
verses.text: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living being say, “Come!”
Then another horse came forth, fiery red in color. Its rider was authorized to remove peace from the earth and to make people slaughter one another. He was given a large sword.

verses.heading: Third Seal: The Black Horse and Famine on Earth / Third Seal: The Black Horse and Famine on Earth
verses.text: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living being say, “Come!” I looked, and there before me appeared a black horse! Its rider was holding a pair of scales in his hand.

Then I heard what seemed to be a voice coming from among the four living beings, announcing, “A quart of wheat for a day’s wages, and three quarts of barley for a day’s wages, but do not damage the olive oil and the wine!”

verses.heading: Fourth Seal: The Pale Green Horse and Death and Hades / Fourth Seal: The Pale Green Horse and Death and Hades
verses.text: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living being say, “Come!”

I looked, and there before me appeared a pale green horse! Its rider was named Death, and Hades followed close behind him. They were granted authority over one-fourth of the earth to kill by sword, famine, plague, and by the wild animals of the earth.

verses.heading: Fifth Seal: The Loud Cries of the Martyrs / Fifth Seal: The Loud Cries of the Martyrs
verses.text: When He opened the fifth seal, I saw beneath the altar the souls of those who had been slaughtered because they had proclaimed God’s word and because they had maintained their faithful testimony.
They cried out in a loud voice, “How long, holy and true Sovereign Lord, until You judge the inhabitants of the earth and avenge our blood?”

Then each of them was given a white robe, and they were instructed to rest a little longer, until the complete number of their fellow servants and brothers and sisters who were destined to be killed just as they had been was reached.

verses.heading: Sixth Seal: Cosmic Catastrophes / Sixth Seal: Cosmic Catastrophes
verses.text: I watched as He opened the sixth seal, and a massive earthquake occurred. The sun turned black like coarse sackcloth made from goat hair, and the entire moon became like blood.
The stars of the sky fell to the earth like a fig tree drops its late figs when shaken by a violent wind.
The sky split apart like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was displaced from its location.
Then the kings of the earth, the nobility, the military commanders, the wealthy, the powerful, and every slave and free person hid themselves in caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
They called out to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us and conceal us from the face of the One seated on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb!
For the great day of Their wrath has arrived, and who has the ability to withstand it?”

verses.heading: The Sealing of the 144,000 of Israel / The Sealing of the 144,000 of Israel
verses.text: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, restraining the four winds of the earth so that no wind would blow on the land or on the sea or on any tree.
Then I saw another angel ascending from the east, carrying the seal of the living God. He shouted in a loud voice to the four angels who had been authorized to damage the land and the sea,
declaring, “Do not damage the land or the sea or the trees until we have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads.”
Then I heard the number of those who were sealed: 144,000 sealed from every tribe of the descendants of Israel:
From the tribe of Judah, 12,000 were sealed, from the tribe of Reuben, 12,000, from the tribe of Gad, 12,000,
from the tribe of Asher, 12,000, from the tribe of Naphtali, 12,000, from the tribe of Manasseh, 12,000,
from the tribe of Simeon, 12,000, from the tribe of Levi, 12,000, from the tribe of Issachar, 12,000,
from the tribe of Zebulun, 12,000, from the tribe of Joseph, 12,000, from the tribe of Benjamin, 12,000 were sealed.

verses.heading: A Great Multitude of Believers from All Nations / A Great Multitude of Believers from All Nations
verses.text: After this I looked, and there before me was an enormous multitude that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people group, and language, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were clothed in white robes and held palm branches in their hands.
They shouted in a loud voice, “Salvation belongs to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”
All the angels were standing in a circle around the throne, around the elders, and around the four living beings. They prostrated themselves face-down before the throne and worshipped God,
declaring, “Amen! Praise and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and strength belong to our God throughout all the ages. Amen!”
Then one of the elders addressed me, asking, “These people clothed in white robes—who are they, and where did they come from?”

I responded, “Sir, you are the one who knows.” He said to me, “These are the ones who have emerged from the great tribulation. They have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
For this reason, they stand before God’s throne and serve Him day and night in His temple sanctuary; and the One who sits on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.
They will never hunger again; they will never thirst again. The sun will never beat down on them, nor any scorching heat.
For the Lamb at the center of the throne will shepherd them and will guide them to springs of living water, and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”

verses.heading: The Seventh Seal and the Golden Censer / The Seventh Seal and the Golden Censer
verses.text: When He opened the seventh seal, silence fell over heaven for approximately half an hour.
Then I saw the seven angels who stand in God’s presence, and seven trumpets were given to them.

Another angel, holding a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given a large quantity of incense to offer, along with the prayers of all the saints, on the golden altar that was set before the throne.
The smoke of the incense, mingled with the prayers of the saints, ascended from the angel's hand into God’s presence.
Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it down upon the earth. There followed peals of thunder, rumblings, lightning flashes, and an earthquake.

verses.heading: The Trumpets / The Trumpets
verses.text: Then the seven angels holding the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound them.

verses.heading: First Trumpet: The Burning of Vegetation / First Trumpet: The Burning of Vegetation
verses.text: The first angel sounded his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood came down and was hurled upon the earth. One-third of the earth was burned up, one-third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.

verses.heading: Second Trumpet: The Sea Struck / Second Trumpet: The Sea Struck
verses.text: The second angel sounded his trumpet, and something resembling an enormous mountain blazing with fire was hurled into the sea. One-third of the sea turned into blood,
one-third of the living creatures in the sea died, and one-third of the ships were destroyed.

verses.heading: Third Trumpet: The Waters Struck / Third Trumpet: The Waters Struck
verses.text: The third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star blazing like a torch fell from the sky. It fell on one-third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
The name of the star is Wormwood. One-third of the waters became bitter like wormwood, and many people died from drinking the waters that had become bitter.

verses.heading: Fourth Trumpet: The Striking of the Sun, Moon, and Stars / Fourth Trumpet: The Striking of the Sun, Moon, and Stars
verses.text: The fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and one-third of the sun was struck, one-third of the moon, and one-third of the stars, so that one-third of them became dark. One-third of the day lost its light, and likewise one-third of the night.

As I watched, I heard an eagle flying through midair, crying out in a loud voice, “Horror, horror, horror awaits the inhabitants of the earth because of the remaining trumpet blasts that the three angels are about to sound!”

verses.heading: Fifth Trumpet: The Emergence of the Locusts from the Bottomless Pit / Fifth Trumpet: The Emergence of the Locusts from the Bottomless Pit
verses.text: The fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from the sky to the earth. The star was given the key to the shaft leading to the bottomless pit.
When he opened the shaft, smoke billowed up from it like smoke from a gigantic furnace. The sun and the atmosphere were darkened by the smoke from the shaft.
Out of the smoke, locusts descended upon the earth, and they were given power like the power that scorpions of the earth possess.
They were instructed not to damage the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those people who did not have God’s seal on their foreheads.
The locusts were not authorized to kill them but only to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the agony caused by a scorpion when it stings a person.
During those days people will seek death but will never find it; they will long to die, but death will elude them.
The appearance of the locusts was like horses prepared for battle. On their heads they wore what appeared to be crowns resembling gold, and their faces looked like human faces.
Their hair was like women’s hair, and their teeth were like lions' teeth.
They had breastplates that looked like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the thundering of many horses and chariots charging into battle.
They possessed tails with stingers like scorpions, and in their tails was their power to inflict pain on people for five months.
Ruling over them as king was the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek his name is Apollyon.
The first catastrophe has passed; two more catastrophes are still coming.

verses.heading: Sixth Trumpet: The Release of the Angels Bound at the Euphrates / Sixth Trumpet: The Release of the Angels Bound at the Euphrates
verses.text: The sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice emanating from the four horns of the golden altar that stands before God.
The voice said to the sixth angel who held the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.”
So the four angels who had been kept ready for this precise hour, day, month, and year were released to kill one-third of humanity.
The number of mounted troops was two hundred million. I heard their number.

In my vision I saw the horses and their riders: They wore breastplates that were fiery red, dark blue, and sulfur yellow. The heads of the horses resembled lions’ heads, and from their mouths came fire, smoke, and sulfur.
One-third of humanity was killed by these three plagues—by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur pouring from their mouths.
For the power of the horses was located in their mouths and in their tails; their tails were like serpents, equipped with heads, and with them they inflict injury.

The rest of humanity who were not killed by these plagues still refused to repent of the works of their hands. They did not stop worshipping demons and idols made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood—idols that cannot see or hear or walk.
They did not repent of their murders, their sorcery, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.

verses.heading: The Mighty Angel and the Little Scroll / The Mighty Angel and the Little Scroll
verses.text: Then I saw another mighty angel descending from heaven. He was wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow over his head. His face shone like the sun, and his legs were like pillars of fire.
He was holding a small scroll that lay open in his hand. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
Then he shouted with a loud voice like a lion roaring. When he shouted, the seven thunders spoke with their own voices.
When the seven thunders had spoken, I was about to write, but I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up what the seven thunders have said and do not write it down.”
Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand toward heaven.
He swore an oath by the One who lives throughout all the ages, who created heaven and everything in it, the earth and everything in it, and the sea and everything in it: “There will be no more delay!
But in the days when the seventh angel is about to sound his trumpet, God’s mysterious plan will be fulfilled, just as He announced to His servants the prophets.”
Then the voice I had heard from heaven spoke to me again: “Go, take the scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land.”

So I approached the angel and asked him to give me the small scroll. He said to me, “Take it and eat it completely. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will taste as sweet as honey.”
I took the small scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it completely. In my mouth it tasted as sweet as honey, but when I had swallowed it, my stomach turned bitter.
And I was told, “You must prophesy again concerning many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

verses.heading: The Two Prophetic Witnesses / The Two Prophetic Witnesses
verses.text: Then a reed resembling a staff was given to me, and someone said, “Get up and measure God’s temple sanctuary and the altar, and count those who are worshipping there.
But leave the outer courtyard unmeasured and excluded, for it has been handed over to the Gentile nations, and they will trample the holy city underfoot for forty-two months.
I will commission My two witnesses, and they will proclaim God’s message for 1,260 days while dressed in sackcloth.”
These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
If anyone attempts to harm them, fire pours out from their mouths and consumes their adversaries. Yes, if anyone wants to harm them, this is how that person must die.

These witnesses possess authority to shut the sky so that no rain falls during the period of their prophetic ministry. They also possess authority to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with any plague whenever they choose.
When they complete their testimony, the beast that rises out of the abyss will wage war against them and will conquer them and put them to death.
Their corpses will lie in the public street of the great city that is spiritually identified as Sodom and Egypt—the same place where their Lord was crucified.
People from various nations, tribes, languages, and ethnic groups will stare at their corpses for three and a half days and will refuse to permit their bodies to be placed in a tomb.
The earth’s inhabitants will rejoice over them and celebrate and exchange gifts with one another, because these two prophets had brought torment to those living on the earth.
But after three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered them, and they stood upright on their feet. Great terror seized those watching them.
Then they heard a powerful voice from heaven calling to them, “Come up here!” And they ascended into heaven in a cloud while their enemies watched them go.

In that same hour, a violent earthquake struck, and one-tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand individuals perished in the earthquake, and the rest were filled with fear and gave glory to the God of heaven.
The second catastrophe has ended; the third catastrophe is approaching quickly.

verses.heading: The Seventh Trumpet / The Seventh Trumpet
verses.text: Then the seventh angel blew his trumpet, and loud voices rang out in heaven, proclaiming, “The kingdom of this world has now become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign throughout all the ages to come.”
Then the twenty-four elders who sit on their thrones in God’s presence prostrated themselves face-down and worshiped God,
declaring: “We give You thanks, Lord God Almighty, the One who exists now and who has always existed, because You have seized Your great power and have assumed Your reign.

The nations raged in fury, but Your wrath has arrived, along with the appointed time for the dead to be judged, the time to grant rewards to Your servants the prophets and to the saints and to all who fear Your name, whether insignificant or influential— and the time to destroy those who are destroying the earth.”

Then God’s temple in heaven was opened, and the ark of His covenant became visible inside His temple. There followed lightning flashes, rumblings, peals of thunder, an earthquake, and a violent hailstorm.

verses.heading: The Woman, the Child, and the Dragon / The Woman, the Child, and the Dragon
verses.text: A striking vision appeared in heaven: A woman clothed in radiant light like the sun, standing upon the moon, and crowned with twelve stars.
She was pregnant and cried out in the agony of labor.
Another sign appeared: A massive red dragon, terrifying in appearance, with seven heads and ten horns, each head crowned.
With a sweep of his tail he hurled a third of the stars from the sky down to the earth. He stationed himself before the woman, waiting to devour her Child as soon as He was born.
She gave birth to a Son—a male Child—destined to rule the nations with unbreakable authority. But the Child was caught up to God and to His throne.
The woman fled into the wilderness, to a place God had prepared, where she would be sustained for 1,260 days.

verses.heading: Satan and His Angels Cast Out of Heaven / Satan and His Angels Cast Out of Heaven
verses.text: A war broke out in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon. The dragon and his angels resisted,
but they were overpowered and expelled; there was no longer any place for them in heaven.
The great dragon—the ancient serpent known as the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world—was cast down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

Then a loud declaration resounded in heaven: “Now salvation, power, and the kingdom of our God have been established, and the authority of His Christ is revealed. The accuser of our brothers and sisters has been cast down—the one who constantly accused them before God.
They overcame him through the blood of the Lamb and through their faithful testimony; they did not cling to life, even in the face of death.
Therefore rejoice, O heavens! But disaster looms over the earth and sea, for the devil has come down in fury, aware that his time is limited.”

verses.heading: Satan Pursues the Woman and Engages in War with Her Children / Satan Pursues the Woman and Engages in War with Her Children
verses.text: Realizing he had been cast to earth, the dragon pursued the woman who had given birth to the male Child.
But she was given the two wings of the great eagle to escape swiftly into the wilderness, where she was sustained for a time, and times, and half a time, beyond the serpent’s reach.
The serpent spewed out a torrent like a river to sweep her away,
but the earth intervened, swallowing the flood and rescuing her.
Enraged, the dragon turned to wage war against the rest of her offspring—those who remain obedient to God and loyal to the testimony of Jesus.
And he stood on the sand of the seashore.

verses.heading: The Beast from the Sea / The Beast from the Sea
verses.text: From the sea I saw a beast emerge, bearing ten horns and seven heads. And on his horns were ten crowns, and blasphemous names marked his heads.
He resembled a leopard, with feet like a bear and a mouth like a lion. The dragon granted him his power, his throne, and sweeping authority.
One of his heads appeared fatally wounded, yet the wound had been healed. The world was astonished and followed him.
People worshipped the dragon for empowering the beast, and they worshipped the beast, saying, “Who can compare to him? Who can defeat him?”
He was allowed to speak arrogant and blasphemous words and to exercise authority for forty-two months.
He uttered blasphemies against God—His name, His dwelling, and those who belong to heaven.
He was permitted to make war against God’s people and overcome them, and he was granted authority over every people group and nation.
All inhabitants of the earth will render worship to him—every person whose name has not been written in the book of life belonging to the Lamb slaughtered from the foundation of the world.
Let all who are willing to hear pay attention:
Those destined for captivity will go into captivity; those destined for death by the sword will face it. This calls for perseverance and steadfast faith from God’s people.

verses.heading: The Beast Rising from the Earth / The Beast Rising from the Earth
verses.text: Then I saw another beast rising from the earth. He had two horns like a lamb but spoke with the voice of a dragon.
He operated with the full authority of the first beast and compelled the world to worship that first beast—the one whose fatal wound had been healed.
He performed astonishing signs, even calling fire down from heaven before people’s eyes.
Through these signs he deceived humanity, urging them to construct an image honoring the beast who was wounded by the sword and yet lived.
He was permitted to animate the image so that it could speak and demand death for those who refused to worship it.
He enforced a mark upon everyone—regardless of status or wealth—on the right hand or forehead,
making participation in commerce impossible without this mark, which represented the beast’s name or number.
This requires discernment. Whoever has insight should calculate the beast’s number, for it represents the number of a man: 666.

verses.heading: The Lamb and the 144,000 / The Lamb and the 144,000
verses.text: I looked again and saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion. With Him were 144,000 people who bore His name and His Father’s name written on their foreheads—openly marked as belonging to God.
I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of many waters and like peals of thunder. The voice which I heard was like harpists skillfully playing their harps.
They sang a new song in the presence of the throne, before the four living creatures and the elders. No one else could master this song except the 144,000—those redeemed out of the world.

These are those who have remained spiritually pure and wholly devoted to the Lamb. They follow Him wherever He leads. Having been redeemed from among humanity, they are presented as firstfruits belonging to God and to the Lamb.
No deceit was found in their mouths; they stand before God without accusation.

verses.heading: The Proclamations of the Three Angels / The Proclamations of the Three Angels
verses.text: Then I saw another angel flying high overhead, carrying an everlasting message of good news to proclaim to every nation, tribe, language, and people on earth.
He cried out loudly: “Revere God and honor Him, because the time of His judgment has arrived. Worship the Creator—the One who made heaven, earth, sea, and the springs of water.”
A second angel followed, declaring, “Babylon the great has fallen—she who caused all the nations to drink from the wine of the passion of her sexual corruption.”
A third angel followed them, warning with a loud voice: “If anyone gives allegiance to the beast and its image, and accepts its mark on the forehead or hand,
that person will also drink the wine of God’s fury—poured undiluted into the cup of His wrath. Such a one will face torment with fire and sulfur before the holy angels and before the Lamb.
The smoke of their suffering rises without end, and there is no rest day or night for those who worship the beast and bear his mark.”
This calls for the steadfast endurance of God’s people—those who obey His commandments and remain faithful to Jesus.

Then I heard a voice from heaven instructing, “Write this: Blessed are those who die in the Lord from this time forward.” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “they will rest from their toil, for the fruit of their faithfulness accompanies them.”

verses.heading: The Harvest of the Earth / The Harvest of the Earth
verses.text: I looked again and saw a white cloud, and seated upon it was one resembling a son of man. He wore a golden crown and held a sharp sickle in His hand.
Another angel came out from the heavenly sanctuary and called out, “Swing Your sickle and reap, because the time to reap has come, for the harvest of the earth is fully ripe.”
The One seated on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.

verses.heading: The Trampling of the Great Winepress of the Wrath of God / The Trampling of the Great Winepress of the Wrath of God
verses.text: Then another angel came from the heavenly temple, also holding a sharp sickle.
Yet another angel, who had authority over fire, came from the altar and shouted to the one with the sickle: “Gather the grape clusters from the earth’s vine, because they are fully ripe.”
The angel swung his sickle and collected the grapes of the earth, throwing them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.

The winepress was trampled outside the city, and blood poured forth from the press, rising to the height of horses’ bridles and extending across a distance of 1,600 stadia or approximately 180 miles—portraying the overwhelming scale of judgment.

verses.heading: Preparation for the Bowl Judgements / Preparation for the Bowl Judgements
verses.text: Then I saw another extraordinary sign in heaven: seven angels carrying seven final plagues. Through these, God’s wrath reaches its completion.
I also saw something like a sea of glass, glowing with fire. Standing beside it were those who had overcome the beast, its image, and the number of its name. They held harps given by God
and sang the song of Moses, God’s servant, and the song of the Lamb: “Your deeds are magnificent and awe-inspiring, Lord God Almighty. Your ways are just and true, King of the nations.
Who will not fear You, Lord, and glorify Your name? You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, because Your righteous acts have been revealed.”
After this, I saw the heavenly sanctuary—the tent of testimony—opened.
The seven angels emerged from it, clothed in pure, radiant linen and wearing golden sashes across their chests.
One of the four living creatures handed them seven golden bowls filled with the wrath of God, who lives forever.
The sanctuary was filled with smoke from God’s glory and power, and no one could enter it until the seven plagues carried by the seven angels were completed.
Then I heard a powerful voice coming from the heavenly sanctuary instructing the seven angels: “Go and pour out upon the earth the seven bowls that contain the outpouring of God’s wrath.”

verses.heading: The First Bowl: A Noxious and Grievous Sore / The First Bowl: A Noxious and Grievous Sore
verses.text: The first angel emptied his bowl onto the earth, and painful, festering sores broke out on those who bore the beast’s mark and who had pledged allegiance to his image.

verses.heading: The Second Bowl: The Sea Turns into Blood / The Second Bowl: The Sea Turns into Blood
verses.text: The second angel poured his bowl into the sea, and it became like the blood of a dead person. Every living creature in the sea perished.

verses.heading: The Third Bowl: The Water Turns into Blood / The Third Bowl: The Water Turns into Blood
verses.text: The third angel poured his bowl into the rivers and springs, and they too turned into blood.
Then I heard the angel responsible for the waters declare: “You are just, O Eternal One— You who are and who were— for in these judgments You act righteously.
Because they shed the blood of Your holy people and prophets, You have given them blood to drink. It is what they deserve.”
And I heard the altar or a voice from the altar affirming: “Yes, Lord God Almighty, Your judgments are true and altogether just.”

verses.heading: The Fourth Bowl: The Sun Scorches People / The Fourth Bowl: The Sun Scorches People
verses.text: The fourth angel poured out his bowl upon the sun, and it was permitted to intensify its heat and burn people with fierce fire.
Though they were scorched by the blazing heat, they cursed the name of God, who has authority over these plagues. Yet they refused to repent or give Him glory.

verses.heading: The Fifth Bowl: Darkness and Distresses / The Fifth Bowl: Darkness and Distresses
verses.text: The fifth angel poured his bowl upon the throne of the beast, plunging his realm into oppressive darkness. People writhed in anguish, biting their tongues because of their pain.
Still they cursed the God of heaven because of their suffering and sores, and they would not turn away from their deeds.

verses.heading: The Sixth Bowl: The Drying up of the Euphrates / The Sixth Bowl: The Drying up of the Euphrates
verses.text: The sixth angel poured his bowl upon the great river Euphrates, and its waters dried up, preparing the way for rulers from the east.
Then I saw three unclean spirits, resembling frogs, coming out from the mouths of the dragon, the beast, and the false prophet.
These were demonic spirits performing signs. They went out to the rulers of the whole world to assemble them for battle on the great day of God Almighty.
(A voice interrupts: “See, I am coming unexpectedly, like a thief. Blessed is the one who remains alert and spiritually prepared, so that he will not be exposed in shame.”)
And they gathered the rulers together at the place known in Hebrew as Armageddon.

verses.heading: The Seventh Bowl: Judgments on the Great City, Islands, Mountains, and People / The Seventh Bowl: Judgments on the Great City, Islands, Mountains, and People
verses.text: The seventh angel poured his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came from the throne in the temple declaring, “It is accomplished.”

Suddenly brilliant lightning flashed, accompanied by rumblings, loud voices, and peals of thunder. Then a massive earthquake struck—unlike anything humanity had ever experienced since people first inhabited the earth. It was unparalleled in its intensity and destructive force.
The great city was torn into three sections, and the cities of the nations collapsed. God remembered Babylon the great and gave her the cup filled with the wine of His fierce wrath.
Islands vanished, and mountains disappeared.
Massive hailstones, each weighing about a talent, fell from the sky upon people. Yet instead of repenting, they cursed God because the plague was so devastating.

verses.heading: The Great Prostitute and the Beast / The Great Prostitute and the Beast
verses.text: Then one of the angels who had carried the bowls approached me and said, “Come, I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits over many waters.
The kings of the earth have committed sexual immorality with her, and the inhabitants of the earth have become intoxicated with the wine of her sexual corruption.”
In the Spirit he carried me into a wilderness, where I saw a woman seated upon a scarlet beast covered with blasphemous names and possessing seven heads and ten horns.
The woman was clothed in luxurious purple and scarlet garments and adorned with gold, jewels, and pearls. In her hand she held a golden cup filled with abominations and moral filth.
On her forehead was written a symbolic name: “Babylon the great, mother of prostitutes and of earth’s abominations.”
I saw that she was drunk—not with wine—but with the blood of God’s holy people and of those who bore witness to Jesus. When I saw her, I was astonished.
The angel said to me, “Why are you amazed? I will explain the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, with its seven heads and ten horns.

The beast you saw once existed, now appears absent, yet will emerge from the abyss before going to destruction. Those whose names were never written in the book of life from the world’s foundation will be astonished when they see this beast—because it once was, now is not, and yet will come.
This calls for wisdom. The seven heads represent seven mountains on which the woman sits, and they also signify seven rulers.
Five have fallen, one currently reigns, and another is yet to come—and his reign will be brief.
The beast who once was, and now is not, stands as an eighth and is headed for ruin.
The ten horns represent ten rulers who have not yet received kingdoms, but they will receive authority for a short time alongside the beast.
