They are united in purpose and willingly hand over their power to him.
They will wage war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will overcome them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings—and those who belong to Him are called, chosen, and faithful.”
Then the angel continued: “The waters you saw, where the prostitute sits, represent peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.
The ten horns and the beast will eventually turn against the prostitute. They will strip her, devastate her, and consume her—destroying her completely.
For God has sovereignly moved their hearts to carry out His purpose: They will act together in giving their authority to the beast until God’s words are fulfilled.
The woman you saw represents the great city that exercises dominion over the rulers of the earth.”

verses.heading: Lament Over Babylon the Great / Lament Over Babylon the Great
verses.text: After these things, I saw another angel coming down from heaven, invested with great authority, and the earth was lit up by the splendor of his presence.

He cried out loudly and forcefully: “Babylon the great has collapsed—utterly fallen! She has become a dwelling place for demons, a refuge for every corrupt spirit, a shelter for everything spiritually unclean and detestable.

All nations have drunk of the wine of the passion of her sexual corruption. The rulers of the earth have committed sexual immorality with her, and the traders of the world enriched themselves by feeding on her excess and indulgence.”

verses.heading: Warning to God’s People to Escape Babylon / Warning to God’s People to Escape Babylon
verses.text: Then I heard another voice speaking from heaven: “Come out from her, My people, so that you do not share in her sins and do not suffer the judgments coming upon her.
Her offenses have stacked up as high as heaven itself, and God has not forgotten her crimes.
Give her what she gave to others; pay her back in full—indeed, double— pour out for her a cup twice as strong as the one she prepared for others.

As much as she glorified herself and lived in self-indulgent luxury, give her the same measure of agony and mourning. For she boasts inwardly, ‘I rule as a queen. I am secure, not abandoned, and sorrow will never touch me.’
Because of this arrogance, her disasters will strike suddenly in a single day— death, grief, and famine— and she will be burned up completely, for the Lord God who judges her is mighty.”

verses.heading: Threefold Pronouncement of God’s Judgment on Babylon / Threefold Pronouncement of God’s Judgment on Babylon
verses.text: The kings of the earth who shared her immorality and extravagance will wail when they see the smoke rising from her destruction.
Standing far away in terror, they will cry: “Disaster! Disaster! O mighty city, Babylon the strong! In a single hour your sentence has been carried out!”
The merchants of the world will also weep and mourn over her, because no one buys their cargo anymore—

cargo of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls; fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet; every kind of citron wood; every article of ivory; every article made from the most valuable wood, bronze, iron, or marble;
cinnamon, spice, aromatic substances for burning, myrrh, frankincense; wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat; cattle, sheep, horses, carriages; slaves, and human lives.
They will lament: “All the things you longed for are gone. Your splendor and wealth have vanished, never to return.”
Those who became rich through her will stand at a distance, shaken by fear, weeping and mourning.
They will cry: “Disaster! Disaster! The great city clothed in luxury, adorned with gold and jewels— destroyed in a single hour!”
Sailors, sea captains, traders, and all who make their living from the sea will also stand far off.
Watching the smoke of her burning, they will ask: “Was there ever a city like this?”
Throwing dust on their heads, they will weep and shout: “Disaster! Disaster! The city that made us wealthy through her trade— brought to ruin in a single hour!”
But rejoice over her fall, O heaven— rejoice, saints, apostles, and prophets— for God has finally judged her for what she did to you.”

verses.heading: The Climax of Babylon’s Destruction / The Climax of Babylon’s Destruction
verses.text: Then a powerful angel lifted a massive stone like a millstone and hurled it into the sea, declaring: “With this same force Babylon the great city will be thrown down and will never be found again.
Music and celebration will vanish from her forever. No craftsman will remain, no industry will survive, no sound of work or life will be heard again.
No lamp will ever shine in her streets again. No wedding songs will ever be heard again. Her merchants once ruled the world, and her sorcery deceived the nations.
In her was found the blood of prophets, of God’s people, and of all who were slain across the earth.”

verses.heading: Heaven’s Threefold Praise / Heaven’s Threefold Praise
verses.text: After this, I heard what sounded like a massive crowd in heaven shouting: “Praise the Lord! Salvation, glory, and power belong to our God,
because His judgments are true and just. He has condemned the corrupt system that polluted the earth with immorality, and He has avenged the blood of His servants.”
Once more they shouted: “Praise the Lord! The smoke of her destruction rises forever.”
The twenty-four elders and the four living beings fell down and worshipped God, saying: “Amen! Praise the Lord!”
Then a voice came from the throne: “Praise our God, all His servants— all who fear Him, great and small alike!”
I heard what sounded like a vast multitude, like rushing waters and powerful thunder: “Praise the Lord! For the Lord God Almighty reigns!
Let us celebrate and give Him glory, for the wedding of the Lamb has arrived, and His bride has prepared herself.”
She was given pure, bright linen to wear— the linen symbolizing the righteous acts of God’s people.

verses.heading: The Marriage Supper of the Lamb / The Marriage Supper of the Lamb
verses.text: Then the angel said to me, “Write this down: Blessed are those invited to the Lamb’s wedding feast.” He added, “These are the trustworthy words of God.”
I fell at his feet to worship him, but he said, “Stop! I am a fellow servant with you. Worship God alone. The witness of Jesus is the heart of prophecy.”

verses.heading: Christ the Victorious Warrior / Christ the Victorious Warrior
verses.text: Then I saw heaven opened, and there was a white horse. Its rider is called Faithful and True, and He judges and wages war in righteousness.
His eyes burn like fire, and many crowns rest upon His head. He bears a name known only to Himself.
He is clothed in a robe soaked in blood, and His name is called the Word of God.
The armies of heaven follow Him, riding white horses and wearing clean, bright linen.
A sharp sword comes from His mouth, by which He subdues the nations. He rules them with unyielding authority and executes the wrath of God Almighty.
On His robe and on His thigh is written: “King of kings and Lord of lords.”

verses.heading: The Final Battle and Judgment / The Final Battle and Judgment
verses.text: Then I saw an angel standing in the sun, calling loudly to the birds flying in the midair: “Come, gather for the great feast of God,
to consume the flesh of the kings, generals, mighty warriors, and all people, whether free or enslaved.”
I saw the beast, the rulers of the earth, and their armies assembled to wage war against the rider on the horse and His army.

The beast was captured, along with the false prophet who had carried out miraculous signs in the beast’s presence—signs through which he deceived those who had accepted the beast’s mark and given allegiance to its image. Both were thrown alive into the lake of fire, a place of burning sulfur.
The remaining forces were destroyed by the sword from Christ’s mouth, and the birds were filled with their flesh.

verses.heading: The Binding of Satan / The Binding of Satan
verses.text: I saw an angel descending from heaven, holding authority over the abyss and carrying a heavy chain.
He overpowered the dragon—the ancient serpent known as the devil and Satan—and bound him for a thousand years.
He confined him to the abyss, shutting and sealing it, so that he could no longer deceive the nations during this appointed period. Afterward, he must be released briefly, according to God’s purpose.

verses.heading: The Millennial Reign of Christ / The Millennial Reign of Christ
verses.text: I then saw thrones, and those seated on them were granted authority to judge. I also saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of their witness to Jesus and their loyalty to God’s word. They had refused allegiance to the beast and its image and had not accepted its mark. They were raised to life and reigned together with Christ for a thousand years.
The rest of the dead were not raised until this period had ended. This is the first resurrection.
Those who share in it are blessed and set apart for God. The second death has no claim over them. They serve God and Christ as priests and reign with Him throughout this thousand-year reign.

verses.heading: The Final Defeat of Satan / The Final Defeat of Satan
verses.text: When the thousand years are completed, Satan will be released from his confinement.
He will again mislead the nations across the whole earth—symbolized by Gog and Magog—assembling them for rebellion. Their number will be vast beyond counting.
They will advance across the land and surround God’s people and the city He loves. But fire will descend from heaven and destroy them.
The devil, who deceived them, will be cast into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet already are, and they will face unending judgment.

verses.heading: The Great White Throne Judgment / The Great White Throne Judgment
verses.text: Then I saw a great white throne and the One seated upon it. The earth and the sky fled from His presence, leaving no place to hide.

All the dead, from the least to the greatest, were standing before the throne. Books were opened, and another book was opened—the book of life. Each person was judged on the basis of their deeds, as they were written in the books.
The sea gave up its dead, and Death and Hades released those under their power. All were judged individually according to what they had done.
Death and Hades themselves were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
Anyone whose name was not found written in the book of life was also thrown into the lake of fire.

verses.heading: The New Heaven and the New Earth / The New Heaven and the New Earth
verses.text: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the former creation had passed away, and the sea was no more.
I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, descending from God out of heaven, prepared like a bride beautifully dressed for her husband.

Then I heard a powerful voice coming from the throne announcing, “Look—the dwelling place of God is with men. He will live with them, and they will belong to Him. God Himself will be present with them as their God.
He will remove every tear from their eyes, and death will no longer exist. There will be no mourning, no crying, and no pain anymore, because the former world and its suffering have come to an end.”
The One seated on the throne said, “I am making all things new.” Then He said, “Write this down, for these words are faithful and true.”
He said to me, “It is finished. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end—the origin and the goal of all things. To anyone who thirsts, I will freely give water from the spring of life.
Those who overcome will inherit these blessings. I will be their God, and they will be My children.
But the fearful, unbelieving, morally corrupt, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars will be sentenced to the lake of fire, which is the second death.”

verses.heading: The New Jerusalem / The New Jerusalem
verses.text: One of the angels who carried the final plagues said to me, “Come, I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.”
Carried by the Spirit to a great and high mountain, he showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, descending from God in heaven.
It reflects God’s glory, shining like a precious jewel, like a jasper, clear and radiant.
The city has a great and high wall with twelve gates, guarded by angels, and inscribed with the names of Israel’s twelve tribes.
There are three gates on each side of the city—east, north, south, and west.
The city wall has twelve foundations bearing the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
The angel measured the city and its gates and walls with a golden measuring rod.

The city is designed with perfect symmetry, forming a square, with its length and width identical. When the angel measured it with the measuring rod, it extended 12, 000 stadia in every direction—its length, width, and height all being the same.
He also measured its wall, which was 144 cubits thick, using the standard human measurement that the angel likewise employed.
The wall is built of jasper, and the city itself is made of pure gold, clear like glass.
The foundations of the city’s wall are adorned with every variety of precious stone. The first foundation is jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, the twelfth amethyst.
The twelve gates are twelve pearls, each one of the gates was made from a single pearl. And the street of the city is pure gold, like transparent glass.
I saw no temple there, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb themselves are its temple.
The city needs no sun or moon, for God’s glory illuminates it, and the Lamb is its light.
The nations walk by that light, and earthly rulers bring their honor into it.
Its gates are never shut, because there is no night.
The glory and honor of the nations are brought into it.
Nothing impure will enter—only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

verses.heading: The River of Life / The River of Life
verses.text: The angel showed me the river of life, bright as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and the Lamb.
It runs through the center of the city. On both sides stand the tree of life, producing twelve kinds of fruit, yielding its fruit every month. Its leaves bring healing to the nations.
There will no longer be any curse, and the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and His servants will serve Him.
They will see His face, and His name will be written on their foreheads, marking them as His own.
There will be no night. They will need no lamp or sunlight, because God Himself will give them light, and they will reign forever.

verses.heading: John and the Angel / John and the Angel
verses.text: The angel said, “These words are reliable and true. The Lord, the God who inspires and speaks through the prophets, sent His angel to show His servants what must soon take place.”
“Look, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
I, John, heard and saw these things. Overwhelmed, I fell down to worship the angel who had been showing them to me.
He said to me, “Do not do that. I am a fellow servant with you and with your fellow prophets and with all who keep the words of this book. Direct your worship to God alone.”
Then he told me, “Do not keep the words of this prophecy hidden, because the time for their fulfillment is near.

Let those who persist in wrongdoing continue in it; let those who remain morally defiled remain so. Likewise, let those who are righteous continue to live rightly, and let those who are holy continue in holiness.”
“Pay attention—I am coming soon, and I bring with Me what each person is due, repaying everyone according to what they have done.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end—the first and the last, the origin and the goal of all things.”
Blessed are those who have been cleansed, for they are granted access to the tree of life and are allowed to enter the city through its gates.
Outside remain the dogs and those who practice occult arts, sexual immorality, murder, idolatry, and everyone who loves and lives by falsehood.
“I, Jesus, have sent My angel to testify to you about these matters for the sake of the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the radiant Morning Star.”

The Spirit and the bride extend the invitation, saying, “Come.” Let anyone who hears respond to that call. Let the one who is thirsty come forward; whoever desires may freely receive the water that gives life.
I solemnly warn everyone who hears the words of this prophetic book: If anyone adds to them, God will add to that person the judgments described here.
And if anyone removes anything from the words of this prophecy, God will remove that person’s share in the tree of life and in the holy city described in this book.
The One who testifies to these things declares, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.
May the grace of the Lord Jesus be with all God’s people. Amen.
